recipes.name: Chai with Naan
instructions: Boil water
Add tea and spices
Add milk and sugar
Serve hot with naan

recipes.name: Sherbetwah
instructions: Soak and cook legumes
Add nuts and raisins
Add sugar and spices
Simmer until thick

recipes.name: Bolani
recipes.description: Crispy stuffed flatbread — sold at roadside stalls across Kabul. Potato-leek is the most common filling.
ingredients: Dough: 3 cups flour, water, salt, oil
Filling: 4 potatoes (mashed), 1 leek or green onion, cilantro, salt, pepper
instructions: Make soft dough, rest 20 min
Mix mashed potato with leek, cilantro, salt, pepper
Divide dough into balls, roll into thin circles
Place filling on one half, fold over, seal edges
Fry in shallow oil until golden and crispy on both sides
Drain and serve with yogurt and green chutney

recipes.name: Afghani Omelette
recipes.description: Simple spiced egg dish made in every Afghan home — eaten with fresh naan.
instructions: Sauté onion and tomatoes until soft
Add sliced chili
Crack in eggs, stir gently or leave whole
Cook until set
Top with cilantro
Serve with warm naan

recipes.name: Kabuli Pulao
instructions: Sauté onions
Toast rice
Add water and chickpeas
Cook until tender

recipes.name: Pula
instructions: Boil meat
Fry bread pieces
Layer and serve

recipes.name: Ashak
recipes.description: Leek-filled dumplings in layers of meat and yogurt sauce — one of Afghanistan's most refined dishes.
ingredients: Filling: 3 leeks (finely chopped), 1 green chili, salt, pepper, oil
Meat sauce: ground beef, onion, tomato paste, turmeric
instructions: Make dough, rest 30 min
Prepare leek filling: sauté leeks with chili, cool
Roll dough thin, cut rounds
Fill with leek mixture, pinch into half-moon shapes
Boil in salted water until they float, 4-5 min
Make meat sauce: brown beef with onion, add tomato paste and turmeric
Mix yogurt with crushed garlic and salt
Layer on plate: dumplings, meat sauce, yogurt sauce
Sprinkle with dried mint and oil

recipes.name: Qorma-e-Sabzi
recipes.description: Green spinach stew over rice — a staple of Afghan home cooking.
instructions: Brown meat in oil
Add onion, cook until golden
Add garlic, turmeric, salt
Add water, simmer 20 min
Add spinach and cilantro, cook 15 more min until wilted into the stew
Serve over steamed white rice (chalaw)

recipes.name: Qabuli Pallow
instructions: Brown chicken
Cook rice with onions
Layer with vegetables
Bake until tender

recipes.name: Mantu
recipes.description: Afghanistan's crown jewel dumpling — steamed bundles in layered sauces. Served at celebrations and New Year (Nowruz).
ingredients: Filling: 500g ground beef or lamb, 2 onions (diced), salt, pepper, cumin
Tomato-lentil sauce: red lentils, tomato paste, turmeric
instructions: Make firm dough, rest 30 min
Sauté onions until golden, mix with raw ground meat, season with salt, pepper, cumin
Roll dough very thin, cut into squares
Place filling in center, pinch four corners together into a bundle
Steam in oiled steamer 40-45 min
Make lentil-tomato sauce: cook lentils with tomato paste until thick
Mix yogurt with garlic
Layer on plate: dumplings, lentil sauce, yogurt sauce
Top with dried mint and drizzle of oil

recipes.name: Chopan Kabob
recipes.description: Grilled lamb chops — the pride of every Afghan kabob house. Charcoal heat is non-negotiable.
ingredients: Marinade: 1 onion (grated), salt, pepper, yogurt, oil
instructions: Marinate chops in grated onion, yogurt, salt, pepper, oil for 1+ hour
Grill over hot charcoal 5-7 min per side
Serve on warm naan with raw onion rings, sliced tomatoes, and sumac

recipes.name: Kabuli Pulao
recipes.description: Afghanistan's national dish — lamb buried in spiced rice topped with sweet carrots and raisins. The proper version, not the simplified Kabuli Pulao listed above.
instructions: Brown lamb in oil, remove
Fry onion until deep brown
Return lamb, add water to cover, salt, cumin, cardamom
Simmer 45 min until meat is tender
Remove meat, measure 5 cups broth
In separate pan, fry julienned carrots until slightly caramelized, add raisins, set aside
Par-cook drained rice in broth for 5 min
Layer: rice on bottom, lamb in center, top with more rice
Cover tightly, steam on lowest heat 20 min
Garnish with caramelized carrots, raisins, sliced almonds

recipes.name: Samosas
instructions: Prepare filling
Fill phyllo triangles
Fry until golden

recipes.name: Bolani Kachaloo
recipes.description: Potato-filled fried flatbread — Kabul's favorite street snack.
ingredients: Filling: mashed potatoes, green onion, cilantro, green chili, salt
instructions: Make soft dough, rest
Fill thin rounds with potato mixture
Fold, seal, fry until crispy

recipes.name: Pakora
recipes.description: Crispy vegetable fritters — eaten with green chutney, especially during Ramadan.
instructions: Mix chickpea flour with spices and enough water for thick batter
Dip vegetable slices in batter
Deep fry until golden and crispy
Serve with green chutney

recipes.name: Halwa
instructions: Toast seeds
Make sugar syrup
Combine and press

recipes.name: Firni
recipes.description: Silky milk pudding scented with cardamom and rose water — served at weddings and celebrations.
instructions: Dissolve cornstarch in cold milk
Heat remaining milk with sugar
Add cornstarch mixture, stir constantly until thick
Add cardamom and rose water
Pour into shallow dishes
Chill until set
Top with crushed pistachios

recipes.name: Gosh-e-Fil
recipes.description: Thin, crispy fried pastry dusted with sugar — shaped like elephant ears. A Nowruz tradition.
instructions: Mix dough of flour, eggs, oil, salt — knead until smooth
Rest 20 min
Roll very thin, cut into rectangles
Deep fry until golden and crispy — they puff up like elephant ears
Dust with powdered sugar mixed with cardamom
Sprinkle with crushed pistachios

recipes.name: Sharbat
instructions: Dissolve sugar
Add rose water
Cool and chill

recipes.name: Doogh
recipes.description: Salty yogurt drink — the universal accompaniment to Afghan kabobs and rice dishes.
instructions: Whisk yogurt until smooth
Add cold water gradually, whisk until frothy
Season with salt
Serve over ice topped with dried mint

recipes.name: Kahwa-e-Sabz
recipes.description: Afghan green tea with cardamom — served after every meal and to every guest.
instructions: Boil water with cracked cardamom
Add green tea, steep 5 min
Sweeten with sugar
Serve in small glasses — often re-steeped 2-3 times

recipes.name: Burek
instructions: Mix filling
Layer phyllo
Bake until golden

recipes.name: Cornbread with Yogurt
instructions: Mix dry ingredients
Combine wet
Bake until done

recipes.name: Flija
recipes.description: Albania's most labor-intensive dish — dozens of crêpe layers baked one at a time under a saç. Made for weddings and celebrations.
ingredients: Batter: 4 cups flour, 4 eggs, milk, salt, water
Cream: kajmak (clotted cream) or sour cream
instructions: Make thin crêpe batter
In a large round pan (saç), pour thin layer of batter
Bake under heat until set
Spread cream over, pour another layer of batter
Repeat 15-20 layers, baking each under heat
Cut into wedges — the cross section shows dozens of thin layers
Serve warm with yogurt or honey

recipes.name: Petulla
recipes.description: Puffy fried dough — the Albanian doughnut, eaten with salty feta cheese or sweet honey.
ingredients: Feta cheese or honey to serve
instructions: Mix dough, let rise 1 hour
Pull pieces of dough, stretch thin
Fry in hot oil until puffed and golden
Drain and serve with feta cheese or drizzled with honey

recipes.name: Meat Pie
instructions: Prepare filling
Layer phyllo
Add egg mixture
Bake

recipes.name: Tavë Kosi
instructions: Brown meat
Add yogurt mixture
Bake until set

recipes.name: Byrek me Mish
recipes.description: The meat version of byrek — Albania's most ubiquitous food. Every bakery sells it from early morning.
instructions: Brown meat with onions
Add diced tomatoes, paprika, salt, pepper
Cool filling, mix in egg
Layer filo sheets in oiled pan, brushing oil between layers
Spread filling over middle layers
Top with more filo layers
Score top into squares
Bake at 180°C for 40-45 min until golden and crispy

recipes.name: Tavë Dheu
recipes.description: Baked liver with rice — a specialty of Elbasan, often made for honored guests.
instructions: Sauté onion and liver in butter
Add grated tomato, paprika, chili, oregano
Transfer to baking dish
Add rice and water
Bake at 180°C for 40 min until rice absorbs liquid

recipes.name: Frikase
instructions: Brown chicken
Add vegetables
Simmer

recipes.name: Tavë Elbasani
recipes.description: Albania's most famous baked dish — lamb under a golden yogurt custard. Named for the city of Elbasan.
instructions: Season lamb, brown in butter
Place in deep baking dish
Beat yogurt with eggs, flour, salt, pepper, oregano
Pour yogurt mixture over lamb
Bake at 175°C for 50-60 min until set and golden on top
Center should be custardy, edges slightly puffed

recipes.name: Speca të Mbushur
recipes.description: Stuffed peppers — made across Albania, each family with their own filling recipe.
ingredients: Filling: 400g ground beef, 1 cup rice, 1 onion, tomato paste, parsley, mint, salt, pepper
instructions: Hollow peppers, keep tops
Cook rice halfway, mix with browned meat, onion, herbs, tomato paste
Stuff peppers, replace tops
Stand in baking dish, pour tomato sauce around
Bake at 180°C for 40-45 min
Serve with crumbled feta on top

recipes.name: Fergese Tirane
recipes.description: Tirana's signature dish — roasted peppers, tomato, and cheese baked with eggs. Simple and rich.
instructions: Roast peppers, peel and chop
Make roux with butter and flour
Add chopped tomatoes, cook 10 min
Add peppers and crumbled cheese
Pour into baking dish, crack eggs on top
Bake at 200°C until eggs set and top is golden

recipes.name: Spinach Pie
instructions: Sauté spinach
Mix with cheese
Layer phyllo
Bake

recipes.name: Qofte të Fërguara
recipes.description: Spiced meat patties — found at every Albanian restaurant and family table.
instructions: Mix meat with grated onion, squeezed bread, egg, herbs, spices
Shape into flat oval patties
Fry in oil until browned on both sides
Serve with yogurt and fresh bread

recipes.name: Trilece
recipes.description: Albania's beloved tres leches — soaked in three milks, topped with dark caramel. Found in every pastry shop.
ingredients: Sponge: 6 eggs, 1 cup sugar, 1 cup flour
Milk soak: evaporated milk, condensed milk, cream
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until very thick and pale
Fold in flour gently
Bake sponge at 175°C for 25 min
Poke holes all over warm cake
Mix the three milks, pour over
Refrigerate overnight — the cake absorbs everything
Make dark caramel, pour over top before serving

recipes.name: Baklava
instructions: Layer phyllo
Add nut mixture
Bake
Add honey syrup

recipes.name: Kabuni
recipes.description: Sweet spiced rice from Elbasan — traditionally molded into a dome and served at celebrations.
instructions: Melt sugar in butter until caramelized
Add lamb broth, bring to boil
Add rice, raisins, spices
Cook covered until rice absorbs liquid
Mold into dome shape, invert onto plate
Serve warm — often alongside roast lamb

recipes.name: Sheqerpare
recipes.description: Syrup-soaked butter cookies — Ottoman heritage found across Albanian pastry shops.
ingredients: Cookies: 250g butter, 2 cups flour, 1 cup semolina, 1/2 cup sugar, 2 eggs, baking powder
Syrup: 2 cups sugar, 2 cups water, lemon juice
instructions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs
Mix in flour, semolina, baking powder
Shape into small balls, press an almond into each
Bake at 170°C for 18-20 min — should stay pale
Make syrup: boil sugar and water with lemon juice
Pour hot syrup over warm cookies
Let soak for several hours — cookies become moist and glossy

recipes.name: Turkish Coffee
instructions: Heat water
Add coffee and sugar
Simmer
Serve

recipes.name: Raki
recipes.description: Albania's national spirit — homemade by nearly every family with a vineyard. Offered to every guest who walks through the door.
instructions: Ferment grape pomace or crushed grapes
Distill in copper alembic
Often distill twice for smoother spirit
The clear spirit should be 40-50% ABV
Serve in small glasses at room temperature

imageCredit.author: The original uploader was Blue at Bulgarian Wikipedia.

recipes.name: Boza
recipes.description: Thick, sweet, slightly fermented grain drink — Ottoman heritage, drunk during winter months.
instructions: Cook corn flour or millet into a thin porridge
Cool to room temperature
Let ferment 2-3 days until slightly tangy and thick
Sweeten with sugar
Serve cold, sprinkled with cinnamon

recipes.name: Makroudh
instructions: Mix semolina, flour, butter, oil, sugar, vanilla, baking powder, and salt until crumbly
Knead mixture until it comes together into a dough
Cook dates with butter and cinnamon over low heat for 5 minutes
Roll out dough between two sheets of plastic wrap to 1/4 inch thickness
Spread date filling over dough
Roll up tightly and cut into diamond shapes
Place clove in center of each cookie
Bake at 350°F for 15-20 minutes until golden
Drizzle with warm honey immediately after baking
Cool on wire rack
tips: Traditional Algerian cookie served during celebrations and Ramadan

imageCredit.author: Credits to Mourad Ben Abdallah / Wikimedia Commons

recipes.name: Chorba Frik
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot over medium-high heat
Brown meat on all sides, about 8 minutes
Add onion and cook until softened, 5 minutes
Stir in garlic, tomato paste, and harissa
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes
Pour in broth and bring to boil
Add frik, caraway seeds, and coriander
Reduce heat and simmer for 35-40 minutes until frik is tender
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh cilantro before serving
Serve hot with crusty bread
tips: Popular breakfast soup during spring, made with young wheat grains

recipes.name: Msemen
recipes.description: Flaky, buttery, square-shaped flatbread — eaten for breakfast across Algeria with honey or soft cheese.
instructions: Mix semolina, flour, salt; add water to make soft dough
Rest 15 min
Divide into balls, flatten into squares
Spread butter-oil mixture, fold into layers
Flatten again, cook on griddle until golden both sides
Serve with honey, jam, or soft cheese

recipes.name: Couscous with Lamb Tagine
instructions: Heat olive oil in tagine or large pot over medium-high heat
Brown lamb on all sides, about 10 minutes
Add onions and cook until softened
Stir in tomato paste, ginger, turmeric, saffron, and cinnamon
Add broth and bring to boil
Add carrots and turnips, reduce heat, simmer 30 minutes
Add zucchini, tomatoes, chickpeas, and raisins
Simmer another 20-25 minutes until vegetables are tender
In separate pot, prepare couscous per package directions using broth
Fluff couscous with butter and fork
Mound couscous on serving platter
Arrange vegetables and meat around couscous
Pour some broth over top
Garnish with cilantro and parsley
Serve remaining broth on the side
tips: Algeria's national dish, served at celebrations and Friday family meals

recipes.name: Tlitli
instructions: Make dough with flour, water, and salt; knead until smooth
Let dough rest 30 minutes covered
Divide dough into small pieces and roll each into thin strands
Cut strands into small pieces by hand or with knife
Brown ground meat in large pot with onion and garlic
Add paprika, caraway seeds, and tomato paste
Cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant
Add diced tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes
Pour in broth, harissa, and bay leaves
Bring to boil and carefully add tlitli pieces
Stir frequently to prevent sticking
Simmer 30-35 minutes until pasta is tender
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh cilantro
Serve hot in bowls with broth
tips: Traditional hand-rolled pasta dish from central Algeria

recipes.name: Rechta
recipes.description: Hand-cut pasta steamed over chicken broth — a tradition for Mawlid (Prophet's Birthday) celebrations.
instructions: Make dough, roll thin, cut into long thin noodles
Steam noodles over the chicken broth (couscousier method)
Simmer chicken with onions, chickpeas, cinnamon, vegetables
Steam noodles 20 min, break up, steam again
Butter the noodles
Serve noodles in large dish, top with chicken and vegetables, ladle broth over

recipes.name: Tanjia
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot or clay vessel
Add onions and cook until caramelized, about 15 minutes
Add meat and brown on all sides
Add garlic cloves and cook for 1 minute
Stir in preserved lemon, olives, bay leaves, and spices
Pour in broth and wine if using
Bring to boil, then reduce heat to low
Cover and simmer for 90-120 minutes until meat is very tender
Stir occasionally, adding more broth if needed
The stew should be rich and slightly reduced
Taste and adjust seasoning
Garnish with fresh parsley
Serve with crusty bread
tips: Traditionally cooked slowly in a clay pot, popular in northern Algeria

recipes.name: Rfissa
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot and brown chicken pieces
Remove chicken and set aside
In same pot, sauté onion and garlic until soft
Add turmeric, ginger, and paprika; cook 1 minute
Return chicken to pot
Pour in broth and bring to boil
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 30 minutes
Add lentils and continue simmering 25-30 minutes
Lentils should be soft and chicken very tender
Stir in cilantro, parsley, butter, and lemon juice
Season with salt and pepper
Simmer 5 more minutes
Serve in deep bowls with generous amount of broth
tips: Comfort food made during celebrations and special occasions

recipes.name: Dolma
recipes.description: Stuffed vegetables — every Algerian grandmother has her own filling recipe.
ingredients: Filling: ground lamb, rice, onion, parsley, mint, cumin, paprika
instructions: Hollow vegetables
Mix raw meat with rice, onion, herbs, spices
Stuff vegetables loosely (rice expands)
Stand in pot, pour tomato sauce over
Simmer 40-45 min until rice is cooked and vegetables are tender
Squeeze lemon juice over before serving

recipes.name: Sellou
instructions: Toast peanuts in dry skillet over medium heat for 8 minutes
Remove and lightly toast almonds for 5 minutes
Toast sesame seeds for 2 minutes until fragrant
Coarsely chop roasted nuts
Toast flour in skillet over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly
Combine toasted flour, nuts, sesame seeds, and sugar in bowl
In small saucepan, gently warm oil with vanilla
Pour oil over flour mixture while stirring
Add anise seeds if using
Mix until it resembles coarse wet sand
Press mixture into shaped mold or onto serving platter
Let cool before cutting into pieces
Serve dusted with cinnamon
tips: Traditional energy paste eaten during Ramadan and celebrations

recipes.name: Karantika
instructions: Prepare filling: sauté onion, add meat or mashed potato, cook 10 minutes
Let filling cool, then mix in parsley, eggs, salt, and pepper
Cut phyllo into strips about 3 inches wide
Place spoonful of filling at bottom corner of each strip
Fold into tight triangular rolls
Heat oil to 350°F in deep pan
Fry rolls a few at a time until golden brown, about 3 minutes
Drain on paper towels
Drizzle with honey while still warm
Dust with powdered sugar
Serve warm or at room temperature
tips: Popular pastry served at weddings and special celebrations

recipes.name: Garantita
recipes.description: Baked chickpea cake — Oran's beloved street food, sold from carts everywhere. Called 'karantika' in some regions.
instructions: Mix chickpea flour with water, eggs, oil, cumin, salt
Pour into oiled baking pan
Bake at 200°C for 40-45 min until golden and set
Cut into squares
Serve warm with harissa

recipes.name: Garantita
recipes.description: Algeria's most democratic street food — a baked chickpea custard-cake cut into squares and drowned in harissa. Costs nearly nothing, found on every street corner in Algiers and Oran. Viral for how something so simple and cheap can be so satisfying — the Algerian street food that food bloggers keep discovering.
instructions: Whisk chickpea flour with water until smooth — no lumps
Add egg, olive oil, cumin, salt, pepper
Pour into oiled baking pan
Bake at 200°C for 25-30 min until set and golden on top, custardy inside
Cut into squares
Serve with harissa on top — the harissa is mandatory
This is Algiers' and Oran's cheapest, most beloved street food
In Algeria, garantita costs almost nothing and fills you up — it's the people's food

recipes.name: Baklava
instructions: Mix pistachios, walnuts, sugar, cinnamon, and cardamom
Layer phyllo sheets in buttered 9x13 pan, brushing each with butter
Spread thin layer of nut mixture over phyllo
Repeat phyllo layers and nut mixture, ending with 6 phyllo sheets on top
Brush top with remaining butter
Cut into diamond or triangle shapes with sharp knife
Place whole clove in center of each piece
Bake at 350°F for 35-40 minutes until golden
While baking, combine honey, water, lemon juice, cinnamon stick, and cloves in pot
Heat until just beginning to boil, then remove from heat
When baklava comes out of oven, immediately pour honey syrup over it
Let cool completely before serving
Syrup will soak in as it cools
tips: Luxurious pastry served during special occasions and holidays

recipes.name: Gazelle Horns
instructions: Mix ground almonds, powdered sugar, butter, orange blossom water, vanilla, and salt
Knead into smooth paste, adding water if too dry
Shape filling into thin logs
Cut phyllo into 4-inch squares
Place almond log on diagonal of phyllo square
Fold corners over filling and roll into crescent
Pinch ends to create horn shape
Brush with melted butter
Bake at 350°F for 20-25 minutes until golden
Or fry in oil at 350°F for 2-3 minutes per side
Dust generously with powdered sugar while still warm
Drizzle with honey if desired
Store in airtight container
tips: Delicate pastry shaped like gazelle horns, traditional wedding sweet

recipes.name: Tamina
recipes.description: Prepared to celebrate newborns — the first visitors to an Algerian baby are offered tamina.
instructions: Toast semolina in butter, stirring constantly, until deep golden and fragrant
Remove from heat, stir in honey
Press into a mound on plate
Decorate with cinnamon in diamond patterns
Serve at room temperature

recipes.name: Moroccan Mint Tea
instructions: Boil water in kettle
Add green tea leaves to teapot and pour hot water
Steep 1 minute, then add fresh mint and sugar
Steep another 2-3 minutes
Pour into glasses, preferably traditional tea glasses
Serve hot or over ice
Can be refilled 2-3 times with fresh hot water
tips: Traditional welcome drink served to guests throughout the day

recipes.name: Almond Milk Drink
instructions: Blanch almonds in boiling water for 1 minute
Remove skins by rubbing between hands
Blend almonds with 1 cup water until very fine paste
Strain through fine mesh, pressing to extract all liquid
Combine almond milk with remaining 3 cups water
Add sugar, orange blossom water, and vanilla
Chill thoroughly
Pour over ice into glasses
Garnish with crushed pistachios
Stir before serving
tips: Refreshing drink popular during summer, often served at festivals

recipes.name: Boukha
instructions: Pour 1-2 oz Boukha into glass
Add ice cubes
Top with water or soda to taste (typically 1:1 ratio)
Stir well
Garnish with fresh fig or lemon wedge if desired
Serve immediately
tips: Traditional North African spirit made from Barbary figs, popular aperitif

recipes.name: North African Red Wine
ingredients: 1 bottle North African red wine (14% ABV)
instructions: Chill bottle in refrigerator for at least 1 hour
Open bottle and let breathe for 15 minutes
Pour into wine glasses
Serve at 60-65°F
Enjoy with traditional Algerian dishes or cheese and bread
tips: North African wines complement local cuisine, served at celebrations

recipes.name: Citronnade
recipes.description: Algerian lemonade — elevated with orange blossom water. Served ice-cold in summer.
instructions: Squeeze lemons
Dissolve sugar in a little warm water, add lemon juice
Add cold water and a splash of orange blossom water
Serve over ice with fresh mint

recipes.name: Trinxat
recipes.description: Hearty Andorran mountain dish of mashed potatoes and cabbage fried until crispy.
instructions: Boil potatoes and cabbage until tender
Drain and mash together roughly
Fry bacon until crisp, set aside
Sauté garlic in bacon fat, add potato-cabbage mix
Press into cake, cook until golden on both sides
Top with bacon

recipes.name: Coca de Recapte
recipes.description: Catalan-influenced flatbread topped with roasted vegetables.
instructions: Roll out bread dough into rectangle
Roast peppers and grill eggplant
Arrange vegetables over dough
Drizzle with olive oil, add thyme and salt
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes

recipes.name: Coques de Sucre
recipes.description: Sweet festival flatbread — baked for Sant Joan and village festes across the Pyrenees.
instructions: Roll dough into flat oval shapes
Dimple with fingers, drizzle with oil
Sprinkle generously with sugar, anise, and pine nuts
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 min until edges are golden

recipes.name: Escudella i Carn d'Olla
recipes.description: Andorra's national dish — a rich two-course stew.
instructions: Boil meats in large pot 90 minutes
Add chickpeas, potatoes, carrots, turnip, cabbage
Cook 30 more minutes
Remove meats, slice on platter
Cook pasta in broth
Serve broth with pasta first, then meats and vegetables

recipes.name: Truita de Carreroles
recipes.description: Simple Pyrenean omelette with prized wild mushrooms.
instructions: Slice mushrooms, sauté with garlic in olive oil
Beat eggs with salt and pepper
Pour over mushrooms
Cook until set, fold in half
Garnish with parsley

recipes.name: Embotits amb Mongetes
recipes.full_name: Embotits amb Mongetes (Sausage with White Beans)
recipes.description: Pyrenean comfort food — pork sausage with white beans, eaten on cold mountain evenings.
instructions: Fry sausages whole until browned all over
In same pan, sauté garlic in oil
Add beans, warm through, season
Serve sausages on a bed of beans with parsley

recipes.name: Cunillo
recipes.description: Traditional Andorran braised rabbit in tomato and wine.
instructions: Brown rabbit in olive oil
Sauté onion and garlic
Add grated tomato, cook 10 min
Return rabbit, add wine and herbs
Braise covered on low 45 minutes

recipes.name: Xai al Forn
recipes.description: Slow-roasted lamb shoulder with potatoes.
instructions: Season lamb with herbs
Place with potatoes and garlic in roasting pan
Add wine, drizzle oil
Roast at 180°C for 90 min, basting
Rest 10 min, serve with pan juices

recipes.name: Civet de Senglar
recipes.description: Wild boar braised in red wine with dark chocolate — a Pyrenean hunter's stew made during autumn boar season.
instructions: Marinate boar in red wine with herbs and juniper overnight
Remove meat, pat dry, brown in oil
Sauté onion and carrot
Add flour, cook 2 min
Add marinade wine and bouquet garni
Return meat, bring to simmer
Cook low for 2-2.5 hours until meat falls apart
Stir in dark chocolate at the end — it deepens the sauce
Season and serve with mashed potatoes

recipes.name: Trinxat
recipes.description: Andorra's mountain comfort food — mashed potato and cabbage fried into a crispy cake in pork fat, topped with crispy bacon. A Pyrenean shepherd's dish that went viral as 'the European bubble and squeak' — simple ingredients transformed by the crispy-crust technique.
ingredients: 200g salt pork belly or bacon (thick sliced)
instructions: Boil cabbage and potatoes together until very tender
Drain well and mash together — keep it rough, not smooth
Fry salt pork or bacon until crispy, set aside
In the pork fat, fry garlic briefly
Add the cabbage-potato mash to the pan
Press flat into a cake, fry until a crispy golden crust forms on the bottom
Flip (or finish under broiler) to crisp the other side
Top with the crispy pork
This is mountain survival food — Pyrenean shepherds' fuel for cold days

recipes.name: Pa amb Tomàquet
recipes.description: The simplest and most beloved Pyrenean snack.
instructions: Toast bread
Rub garlic over surface
Rub tomato pulp onto bread
Drizzle olive oil, add salt

recipes.name: Embotits
recipes.description: An Andorran charcuterie board — small-production mountain-cured meats are a point of national pride.
instructions: Slice cured meats thinly
Rub bread with tomato and drizzle olive oil
Arrange meats, bread, and olives on board

recipes.name: Crema Andorrana
recipes.description: Rich custard dessert similar to crema catalana.
instructions: Heat milk with cinnamon and lemon zest
Whisk yolks with sugar and cornstarch
Temper with hot milk, return to heat
Stir until thickened, pour into ramekins
Chill, top with brown sugar and caramelize

recipes.name: Coca de Vidre
recipes.description: Paper-thin crispy cake so delicate it looks like stained glass — made for festivals.
instructions: Mix flour with lard, eggs, sugar, anise, lemon zest
Roll very thin — it should be almost translucent (hence 'glass')
Bake at 180°C for 12-15 min until crispy
Dust with powdered sugar
Break into shards to serve

recipes.name: Hot Chocolate
recipes.description: Thick, rich mountain hot chocolate.
instructions: Chop chocolate
Heat milk with sugar
Dissolve cornstarch in cold milk, add
Add chocolate, stir until thick

recipes.name: Ratafia
recipes.description: Traditional Pyrenean herbal liqueur.
instructions: Quarter green walnuts, place in jar with herbs and spices
Pour spirit over, seal
Macerate 40 days, shaking weekly
Strain, dissolve sugar in warm water, add
Bottle and age 1 month

recipes.name: Vi Calent
recipes.description: Andorra's version of mulled wine — drunk after skiing and during winter festivals.
instructions: Heat wine with spices and orange
Do not boil
Sweeten to taste
Serve in thick mugs

recipes.name: Funge de Milho
recipes.description: Angola's staple starch, served at every meal.
instructions: Bring water and salt to boil
Slowly add cornmeal, stirring constantly
Reduce heat, stir 15 min
Cook until thick and pulls from sides

recipes.name: Pão com Café
recipes.description: Portuguese-influenced Angolan breakfast.
instructions: Toast bread, spread with butter
Brew strong coffee
Sweeten with sugar or condensed milk

recipes.name: Kitaba
recipes.description: Sweet potato fritters — sold at Luanda's morning markets.
instructions: Mash sweet potatoes with eggs, flour, sugar, cinnamon
Shape into small patties
Fry in oil until golden on both sides
Serve warm

recipes.name: Moamba de Galinha
recipes.full_name: Moamba de Galinha (Chicken in Palm Oil)
recipes.description: Angola's national dish — chicken braised in palm oil sauce.
instructions: Season and brown chicken in palm oil
Add onions, cook soft
Add pumpkin, simmer 20 min
Add okra, cook 10 more min
Serve over funge or rice

recipes.name: Calulu de Peixe
recipes.description: Traditional stew combining dried and fresh fish with leafy greens.
instructions: Layer vegetables in pot: onions, tomatoes, greens, okra
Place dried and fresh fish on top
Add palm oil, season
Simmer covered 40 min
Serve with funge or rice

recipes.name: Feijão de Óleo de Palma
recipes.full_name: Feijão de Óleo de Palma (Beans in Palm Oil)
recipes.description: Beans stewed in vibrant red palm oil — everyday Angolan comfort food.
instructions: Cook beans until almost tender
Sauté onion and garlic in palm oil until soft
Add beans with cooking liquid
Add dried fish if using, and bay leaf
Simmer 20 min until beans are very tender and sauce thickens
Serve with rice or funge

recipes.name: Mufete
recipes.description: Angola's quintessential feast plate — grilled fish with all the fixings. A Saturday lunch tradition in Luanda.
ingredients: Palm oil vinaigrette: palm oil, vinegar, onion, garlic
instructions: Score fish, marinate in lime and salt
Grill over charcoal until skin is crispy
Fry ripe banana slices
Boil cassava until tender
Make vinaigrette: mix palm oil, vinegar, diced onion, garlic
Plate everything together — fish, banana, cassava, vinaigrette, farofa

recipes.name: Muamba de Dendém
recipes.description: Rich palm nut stew, a centerpiece of Angolan dinners.
instructions: Brown meat, sauté onions, garlic, tomatoes
Add palm nut cream and 1 cup water
Add meat, simmer 45 min
Add okra and chili, cook 15 more min

recipes.name: Cachupa
recipes.description: Filling one-pot stew of corn, beans, and mixed meats.
instructions: Cook corn and beans until almost tender, 60 min
Add pork and bay leaves
Add sweet potatoes and plantains
Add sliced chorizo
Simmer 30 more min

recipes.name: Kizaca
recipes.description: Cassava leaf and peanut stew — the taste of home for Angolans. Similar to Congolese pondu.
instructions: Boil pounded cassava leaves 30 min
Add peanut paste diluted in water
Add palm oil, dried fish, onion, garlic, chili
Simmer until thick and rich
Serve with funge or rice

recipes.name: Rissóis de Camarão
recipes.description: Crispy shrimp pastries from Portuguese tradition.
instructions: Make dough: heat milk+butter, add flour, stir to ball
Roll thin, cut circles
Sauté onion and chopped shrimp for filling
Fill circles, fold, seal
Egg wash, breadcrumb, deep fry until golden

recipes.name: Ginguba Torrada
recipes.description: Roasted peanuts — sold in paper cones by street vendors across Angola.
instructions: Roast peanuts in dry pan, stirring constantly
Season with salt while hot
Cool — they crisp as they cool

recipes.name: Cocada Amarela
recipes.description: Beloved Angolan dessert of coconut and egg yolks.
instructions: Make syrup with sugar and water
Add coconut, cook until thickened
Remove from heat, stir in yolks one at a time
Return to low heat until set
Pour into mold, top with cinnamon

recipes.name: Doce de Ginguba
recipes.description: Peanut candy — Angola's answer to pé-de-moleque, Portuguese-African sweet heritage.
instructions: Make syrup with sugar and water
Cook to soft ball stage
Add ground peanuts, cinnamon, cloves
Stir until thick
Drop spoonfuls onto greased tray
Let harden

recipes.name: Kissângua
recipes.description: Traditional fermented corn beverage.
instructions: Mix cornmeal with water
Ferment at room temp 2-3 days
Strain, add sugar and cinnamon
Serve cold

recipes.name: Caipirinha Angolana
recipes.description: Angolan take on the Brazilian classic.
instructions: Cut limes into wedges
Muddle with sugar
Add spirit and crushed ice
Stir well

recipes.name: Cuca
recipes.description: Angola's national beer since 1952 — light lager, always ice cold.
instructions: Serve cold
Angola's most popular beer — the yellow and blue label is an icon

recipes.name: Sumo de Múcua
recipes.description: Tangy, creamy juice from the baobab fruit — packed with vitamin C.
instructions: Soak baobab pulp in water
Strain through sieve
Sweeten with sugar
Add lemon juice
Serve very cold

recipes.name: Saltfish and Chop-Up
recipes.description: Antigua's national dish — saltfish with mashed local vegetables.
instructions: Boil and flake salt cod
Cook spinach, eggplant, okra until soft
Mash vegetables roughly
Sauté onion and tomatoes in butter
Add flaked fish, toss with vegetables
Season with thyme and hot pepper

recipes.name: Ducana
recipes.description: Sweet potato dumplings steamed in banana leaves.
instructions: Mix sweet potato, coconut, flour, sugar, spices
Wrap in banana leaves, tie securely
Steam 40 minutes
Unwrap and serve with saltfish

recipes.name: Ducana
recipes.description: Sweet potato and coconut dumplings wrapped in banana leaves — always served with saltfish as Antigua's national dish.
instructions: Mix grated sweet potato with coconut, flour, sugar, spices, raisins
Wrap portions in banana leaves, tie securely
Steam or boil 30 min until firm
Unwrap and serve alongside saltfish

recipes.name: Pepper Pot Soup
recipes.description: Thick, hearty soup with mixed meats and local vegetables.
instructions: Brown meats, add onion, garlic, thyme
Cover with water, simmer 30 min
Add potatoes and plantains
Add spinach and okra
Simmer until tender

recipes.name: Fungi and Pepperpot
recipes.description: Cornmeal with okra alongside spicy meat stew.
instructions: Brown meat, add tomatoes, onion, herbs, simmer 30 min
Boil water with okra
Stir in cornmeal slowly
Cook until thick and smooth
Serve alongside pepperpot

recipes.name: Fungi and Pepperpot
recipes.description: Cornmeal and okra with a green vegetable stew — the other Antiguan national dish. Fungi is stirred constantly for smooth texture.
ingredients: Fungi: cornmeal, okra, water, butter, salt
Pepperpot: spinach or amaranth leaves, eggplant, okra, squash, salted meat, onion, thyme, hot pepper
instructions: Make fungi: boil okra in water, gradually add cornmeal stirring constantly until thick
Make pepperpot: cook salted meat until tender, add all vegetables and seasonings
Simmer until vegetables are soft and stew is thick
Serve fungi alongside pepperpot

recipes.name: Fungee and Pepperpot
recipes.description: Antigua and Barbuda's national dish — cornmeal-and-okra fungee (similar to polenta but slimy from the okra) served with a thick vegetable pepperpot stew. The vigorous stirring technique with the cou-cou stick and the Saturday ritual have made this a viral Caribbean food tradition.
ingredients: Fungee: 2 cups cornmeal, okra (sliced), water, butter, salt
Pepperpot: spinach/dasheen leaves (callaloo), okra, eggplant, squash, salted meat, onion, garlic, thyme, Scotch bonnet
instructions: Make pepperpot: cook salted meat until tender, add all vegetables, thyme, Scotch bonnet
Simmer until vegetables are soft and meld into a thick, green, stewlike consistency
For fungee: boil okra in salted water until slimy (the slime is essential)
Add cornmeal gradually, stirring with a wooden cou-cou stick — circular motions only
Stir vigorously — fungee must be smooth, thick, and pull away from the pot
Turn out fungee onto plate as a dome
Ladle pepperpot around and over the fungee
This is Antigua's national dish — fungee day is Saturday, and everyone eats it

recipes.name: Grilled Lobster with Lime Butter
recipes.description: Fresh Caribbean lobster with zesty lime butter.
instructions: Split lobster tails
Melt butter with garlic and lime
Brush lobster, grill cut-side down 5 min
Flip, baste, grill 5 more min
Garnish with parsley

recipes.name: Jerk Chicken
recipes.description: Smoky, spicy jerk chicken.
instructions: Blend peppers, onions, garlic, seasonings into paste
Marinate chicken 4+ hours
Grill over medium heat, turning
Baste with marinade
Cook until charred through

recipes.name: Goat Water
recipes.description: Rich goat stew with dumplings — the unofficial national stew, served at cricket matches and celebrations.
instructions: Brown goat meat
Add onions, cloves, thyme, scotch bonnet
Cover with water, simmer 90 min
Add tomato paste, breadfruit
Add flour dumplings
Cook 30 more min until everything is tender

recipes.name: Johnny Cakes
recipes.description: Crispy fried dough — a Caribbean street snack.
instructions: Mix dry ingredients, cut in butter, add water
Knead briefly, divide into 8 balls
Flatten slightly
Deep fry until golden
Drain on paper towels

recipes.name: Johnny Cakes
recipes.description: Fried dough rounds — eaten at any time of day across the Caribbean.
instructions: Mix dry ingredients, cut in butter
Add enough liquid to make soft dough
Shape into rounds
Deep fry until golden and puffy
Serve plain or with butter and cheese

recipes.name: Black Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
recipes.description: Made with Antigua's famous sweet black pineapple.
instructions: Melt butter and brown sugar in cake pan
Arrange pineapple slices
Mix batter: flour, sugar, baking powder, eggs, coconut milk, vanilla
Pour over pineapple
Bake at 180°C 40 min, invert while warm

imageCredit.author: Kimberly Vardeman from Lubbock, TX, USA

recipes.name: Black Pineapple Tart
recipes.description: Made with Antigua's famous Black pineapple — one of the sweetest varieties in the world, grown only on the island.
instructions: Cook diced pineapple with sugar and spices until jammy
Line tart pan with pastry
Fill with pineapple mixture
Bake at 180°C for 30-35 min
Cool before slicing

recipes.name: Tamarind Juice
recipes.description: Tangy, refreshing tamarind drink.
instructions: Shell tamarind, soak pulp in warm water 30 min
Squeeze and strain
Sweeten to taste
Serve over ice

recipes.name: Rum Punch
recipes.description: Classic Caribbean rum punch.
instructions: Combine rum, juices, grenadine in pitcher
Add ice, stir well
Pour into glasses
Top with bitters and nutmeg

recipes.name: Sea Moss Drink
recipes.description: Thick, creamy sea moss drink — considered an energy tonic across the Caribbean.
instructions: Soak sea moss overnight until doubled and soft
Boil until completely dissolved
Blend with milk, sugar, vanilla
Strain
Chill and serve cold, dusted with cinnamon and nutmeg

recipes.name: Medialunas
recipes.description: Argentina's answer to the croissant — smaller, sweeter, and glazed. Eaten by the dozen at every bakery.
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm milk with a pinch of sugar
Mix flour, sugar, salt; add yeast mixture and eggs
Knead until smooth, refrigerate 30 min
Roll out, layer cold butter, fold in thirds three times, chilling between folds
Roll final dough, cut triangles, roll into crescent shapes
Rise 1 hour until puffy
Brush with egg wash
Bake at 200°C for 15-18 min until deeply golden
Brush immediately with warm sugar syrup for glaze

recipes.name: Mate con Tostadas
recipes.description: The true Argentine breakfast — bitter mate sipped through a metal straw alongside toast with dulce de leche.
instructions: Fill mate gourd two-thirds with yerba
Tilt gourd so yerba sits on one side
Insert bombilla into the lower part
Pour warm water over the lower side, let absorb
Continue pouring water to drink through bombilla
Toast bread, spread with butter and dulce de leche

recipes.name: Tortilla de Papa
recipes.description: Argentine-style Spanish tortilla — thick, golden, eaten at any hour.
instructions: Fry potato slices in olive oil until tender, not crispy
Add onion slices, cook until soft
Beat eggs with salt and pepper
Drain potatoes, mix into eggs
Pour into oiled skillet, cook on medium-low until edges set
Flip using a plate, cook other side 3 min
Slide onto plate, cut into wedges

recipes.name: Empanadas Salteñas
recipes.description: Salta-style baked empanadas — the juiciest in Argentina, with beef fat dough and a signature crimped edge.
ingredients: Dough: 500g flour, 100g beef fat, 1 tsp salt, warm water
Filling: 500g beef (diced small), 2 onions, 2 hard-boiled eggs, green olives, cumin, paprika, chili flakes, green onion
instructions: Make dough: mix flour, salt, melted beef fat, add water until pliable, rest 30 min
Sauté onions in beef fat, add paprika, cumin, chili
Add diced beef, cook until just done — filling should be juicy, not dry
Cool filling, add chopped egg and olives
Roll dough circles, fill each generously
Fold in half, crimp edges with repulgue (decorative rope fold)
Bake at 220°C for 15-18 min until golden

recipes.name: Milanesa a la Napolitana
recipes.description: Breaded beef topped with ham, tomato, and melted cheese — invented in Buenos Aires, not Naples.
instructions: Pound beef thin, season with salt
Dip in egg, then breadcrumbs
Fry until golden on both sides
Place on baking sheet
Top each with tomato sauce, ham, mozzarella, oregano
Broil until cheese melts and bubbles
Serve with fries or salad

recipes.name: Locro
recipes.description: Argentina's national stew — served on May 25th (Revolution Day) and through winter. Thick, ancient, and warming.
ingredients: Quiquirimichi: red pepper flakes, cumin, oil, green onion
instructions: Cook soaked corn and beans in large pot with plenty of water, 1 hour
Add beef and pork ribs, cook 1 more hour
Add squash, chorizo, onions, bay leaf
Simmer 30 min — squash should dissolve into the broth, thickening it
Season with cumin, paprika, salt
Make quiquirimichi: fry green onion in oil, add pepper flakes and cumin
Serve in deep bowls with quiquirimichi spooned on top

recipes.name: Asado Completo
recipes.description: The sacred Argentine ritual — hours of slow-grilling over wood coals. The asador tends the fire; guests wait patiently.
ingredients: Chimichurri: parsley, oregano, garlic, red pepper flakes, olive oil, red wine vinegar
instructions: Build fire to one side of the grill, let burn down to white coals
Salt meat generously with coarse salt only
Place ribs bone-side down far from coals for slow cooking
Add vacío fat-side down
Grill chorizos and morcillas closer to heat, 15 min
Ribs take 90 min+ over low heat — never rush
Flip vacío once after 40 min, cook 20 more min
Rest all meats 10 min before cutting
Slice against the grain, serve with chimichurri

recipes.name: Carbonada Criolla
recipes.description: Sweet-savory beef stew with peaches and corn — a colonial-era dish from the Pampas.
instructions: Brown beef in oil
Sauté onion and tomatoes
Add paprika, bay leaf, broth
Add potatoes and sweet potato
Simmer 30 min
Add corn rounds and peach halves
Cook 15 more min until everything is tender
The peaches should be soft but hold their shape

recipes.name: Matambre Arrollado
recipes.description: Rolled stuffed flank steak — sliced cold to reveal a colorful spiral. A celebration centerpiece.
instructions: Butterfly matambre if needed, pound thin
Marinate in vinegar, garlic, oregano, salt, pepper overnight
Lay flat, layer spinach, roasted pepper strips, carrot sticks
Place whole hard-boiled eggs in a line down the center
Roll tightly, tie with twine at 3cm intervals
Wrap in foil, simmer in salted water 90 min
Cool under weight in fridge overnight
Slice into pinwheel rounds, serve cold

recipes.name: Choripán
recipes.description: Grilled chorizo sandwich with chimichurri — Argentina's king of street food, sold at every fútbol match.
ingredients: Chimichurri: flat-leaf parsley, garlic, oregano, red pepper flakes, olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt
instructions: Butterfly chorizos lengthwise (don't cut through)
Grill cut-side down first until charred, then flip
Make chimichurri: finely chop parsley, garlic; mix with oregano, pepper flakes, oil, vinegar, salt
Split rolls, place chorizo inside
Spoon chimichurri generously over

recipes.name: Provoleta
recipes.description: Grilled provolone — bubbly and golden, the opening act of every asado.
instructions: Place cheese rounds on hot grill or cast iron
Cook without moving until bottom is golden and crispy, 4-5 min
Flip carefully, cook 2 more min until melty inside
Sprinkle with oregano and pepper flakes
Drizzle with olive oil, eat immediately with bread

recipes.name: Fugazzeta
recipes.description: Buenos Aires' signature pizza — cheese hidden between two crusts, buried under a mountain of onions. Went viral when food creators discovered you can't see the cheese until you cut it. A BA pizzería classic since the 1930s.
ingredients: Dough: 500g flour, 7g yeast, 300ml warm water, 2 tbsp olive oil, salt
Topping: 3 large onions (sliced thin into rings), oregano, olive oil
instructions: Make dough, rise 1 hour
Divide in half — roll bottom crust into greased round pan
Cover with mozzarella cheese
Roll second crust on top, press edges to seal
Pile sliced onions thick on top — they should completely cover the surface
Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle oregano
Bake at 220°C for 20-25 min until golden and onions are soft
The cheese melts inside, creating a stretchy hidden layer

recipes.name: Alfajores de Maicena
recipes.description: Argentina's most beloved cookie — delicate cornstarch shortbread sandwiching dulce de leche, rolled in coconut.
instructions: Cream butter with powdered sugar
Add egg yolks, vanilla, lemon zest
Sift cornstarch, flour, baking powder; fold in
Roll dough 5mm thick, cut rounds
Bake at 160°C for 10-12 min — they should NOT brown, stay pale
Cool completely
Sandwich with generous dulce de leche
Roll edges in shredded coconut

recipes.name: Dulce de Leche Flan
recipes.description: Flan with dulce de leche stirred into the custard and more pooled on top. Sunday lunch dessert across Argentina.
ingredients: Custard: 6 eggs, 500ml whole milk, 200g dulce de leche, 1 tsp vanilla
instructions: Melt sugar in flan mold until amber caramel, swirl to coat
Warm milk, whisk in dulce de leche until dissolved
Beat eggs, temper with warm milk mixture
Strain into caramelized mold
Place in water bath, bake at 160°C for 55-60 min
Jiggle test: center should wobble like jelly, not liquid
Cool, refrigerate overnight
Unmold by running knife around edge, invert onto plate — caramel cascades down

recipes.name: Chocotorta
recipes.description: Argentina's viral birthday cake — no oven needed, no baking skill required. Chocolinas cookies layered with dulce de leche and cream cheese. Went globally viral on TikTok. Every Argentine child grows up eating this at birthday parties.
instructions: Mix cream cheese with dulce de leche until smooth
Briefly dip chocolinas in coffee — just a second, don't soak them
Layer in a rectangular dish: coffee-dipped cookies, dulce de leche cream, repeat
Top layer should be cream
Refrigerate overnight — the cookies soften and meld together
Dust with cocoa powder before serving
Cut into squares

recipes.name: Mate
recipes.description: More than a drink — a social ritual. The cebador (server) prepares and refills; everyone shares one gourd. Argentina's national beverage.
instructions: Fill gourd two-thirds full with yerba mate
Cover opening, flip upside down and shake gently to bring fine dust to top
Tilt so yerba sits at an angle
Pour a small amount of cool water on the lower side, let absorb
Insert bombilla into the wet side
Pour hot water (never boiling) over the lower side
Drink through bombilla until you hear slurping
Refill with hot water, pass to next person in the circle

recipes.name: Fernet con Coca
recipes.description: The bittersweet drink of Argentine nightlife — practically the national cocktail, especially in Córdoba.
instructions: Fill tall glass with ice
Pour Fernet Branca over ice
Top slowly with Coca-Cola
Stir gently once — don't kill the fizz
Drink ratio is personal: Córdoba pours it stronger

recipes.name: Asado
recipes.description: Argentine grilled beef with chimichurri - national pride dish
ingredients: 1.5kg beef short ribs or rib eye steak (2cm thick)
Salt and black pepper to taste

For chimichurri: 1 cup fresh parsley, finely chopped, 1/4 cup fresh oregano, finely chopped, 6 cloves garlic, minced, 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil, 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes, Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Make chimichurri: combine parsley, oregano, minced garlic in bowl
Add olive oil, red wine vinegar, red pepper flakes
Season with salt and pepper
Let chimichurri sit at least 30 minutes to blend flavors (can be made hours ahead)
Prepare grill for medium-high heat (wood charcoal is traditional)
Pat beef dry with paper towels
Season beef generously with salt and pepper on both sides
Place beef on hot grill grates
Grill 25-30 minutes for medium-rare (internal temp 130-135°F), turning occasionally
Do not move meat constantly - let it develop char
Remove beef from grill and let rest 10 minutes (crucial for meat texture)
Slice against the grain
Serve immediately with chimichurri on the side or spooned over meat
Traditional accompaniments: grilled vegetables, salad, crusty bread
tips: Chimichurri is essential - it's the soul of the dish. Resting meat allows juices to redistribute
recipes.fun_fact: Asado is more than food in Argentina - it's a social and cultural tradition bringing people together

recipes.name: Zhingyalov Hats
recipes.description: Thin flatbread stuffed with a dozen wild herbs.
ingredients: 500g mixed herbs (parsley, cilantro, dill, sorrel, spinach, green onions)
instructions: Make dough, rest 20 min
Chop herbs finely, mix together
Roll dough thin, fill with herbs, fold and seal
Cook on dry griddle until spotted brown
Brush with butter

recipes.name: Lahmajun
recipes.description: Paper-thin flatbread with spiced lamb topping.
instructions: Roll dough into thin circles
Mix lamb with vegetables, paste, spices
Spread thin layer on each circle
Bake at 230°C for 8-10 min
Roll up with lemon juice

imageCredit.author: No machine-readable author provided. Rainer Zenz assumed (based on copyright claims).

recipes.name: Lahmajun
recipes.description: Armenian meat flatbread — paper-thin crust with a spiced raw meat topping that bakes in minutes. Often called 'Armenian pizza' but far older.
ingredients: Dough: 500g flour, yeast, water, salt, olive oil
Topping: 400g finely ground lamb, 2 onions (minced), 2 tomatoes (grated), 1 green pepper (minced), parsley, tomato paste, paprika, cumin, Aleppo pepper, lemon juice, salt
instructions: Make thin, soft dough, divide into balls, rest
Mix all topping ingredients — the meat mixture should be almost paste-like
Roll dough balls into very thin circles
Spread thin layer of meat mixture all the way to the edges
Bake on a pizza stone at maximum oven heat (250°C+) for 5-7 min
The base should be crispy, the topping just cooked
Squeeze lemon juice over, add fresh herbs
Roll up and eat by hand

imageCredit.author: No machine-readable author provided. Rainer Zenz assumed (based on copyright claims).

recipes.name: Jajukh
recipes.description: Cold yogurt soup with cucumber and herbs — an Armenian summer staple.
instructions: Whisk yogurt until smooth
Thin with cold water to soup consistency
Add diced cucumber, garlic, dill, mint, salt
Chill thoroughly
Serve cold — especially on hot summer days

recipes.name: Khorovats
recipes.description: Armenia's beloved barbecue tradition.
instructions: Marinate meat with onions, wine, oil, herbs overnight
Thread onto flat skewers
Grill over charcoal
Grill whole tomatoes and peppers alongside
Serve on lavash with fresh herbs

recipes.name: Dolma
recipes.description: Grape leaves stuffed with spiced meat and rice.
instructions: Blanch grape leaves
Mix meat, rice, onions, herbs, spices
Fill leaves, roll tightly
Pack in pot seam-down, add water to cover
Simmer 60 min
Serve with yogurt

recipes.name: Khorovats
recipes.description: Armenia's national BBQ — pork or lamb on flat skewers over charcoal. Every family gathers around the mangal; the person grilling earns the title khorovats-maker.
ingredients: Marinade: 2 onions (grated), salt, pepper, sometimes red wine
instructions: Marinate meat in grated onion, salt, pepper for at least 2 hours — some families marinate overnight
Thread onto wide flat metal skewers (not round bamboo — the flat shape prevents spinning)
Grill over charcoal — the mangal (BBQ) is the center of every Armenian gathering
Turn periodically, 20-25 min total — the exterior should char slightly
Grill whole tomatoes and peppers alongside
Slide meat off skewers onto lavash bread
Serve with fresh herb platter (basil, tarragon, cilantro) and sumac onions

recipes.name: Ghapama
recipes.description: Festive stuffed pumpkin — the centerpiece of Armenian New Year and wedding tables. There's even a folk song about it: 'Hey jan, Ghapama!'
ingredients: Dried fruits: apricots, raisins, prunes, dates
instructions: Cut top off pumpkin, scoop out seeds
Mix cooked rice with dried fruits, nuts, honey, cinnamon, butter
Fill pumpkin with rice mixture
Replace pumpkin lid
Bake at 175°C for 75-90 min until pumpkin flesh is very tender
Bring whole pumpkin to the table — guests scoop filling and soft pumpkin flesh together

recipes.name: Ghapama
recipes.description: Festive whole pumpkin stuffed with honeyed rice and dried fruits.
instructions: Cut top off pumpkin, scoop seeds
Mix rice with fruits, nuts, honey, butter, spices
Fill pumpkin, replace top
Bake at 180°C for 90 min
Cut into wedges

recipes.name: Harissa
recipes.description: Slow-cooked porridge traditionally served at Easter.
instructions: Cook wheat berries 2 hours until very soft
Boil chicken until falling off bone, shred
Add chicken to wheat, stir vigorously
Cook 1 more hour until porridge-like
Top with melted butter and cumin

recipes.name: Tolma
recipes.description: Armenian stuffed grape leaves — the filling includes a trio of fresh herbs. An essential dish for any holiday table.
ingredients: Filling: 500g ground beef and lamb mix, 1 cup rice, 1 onion (diced), tomato paste, parsley, dill, basil, salt, pepper
Plain yogurt with garlic for serving
instructions: Blanch fresh grape leaves briefly, or rinse jarred ones
Mix raw meat with rice, onion, herbs, tomato paste, salt, pepper
Place spoonful on each leaf, fold sides in, roll tightly
Pack tightly in pot seam-side down
Place plate on top to weigh down
Add water to just cover, simmer 40-45 min
Serve with garlic yogurt

recipes.name: Harissa
recipes.description: Ancient Armenian porridge of slow-cooked wheat and chicken — stirred for hours until silky smooth. Made for Easter and religious celebrations.
instructions: Simmer wheat berries in large pot with water 2 hours
Meanwhile, boil chicken until very tender, shred meat, discard bones
Add shredded chicken to wheat, continue simmering
Stir frequently — the wheat breaks down into a thick porridge
Cook 1-2 more hours until completely smooth and thick
Stir in butter
Serve in bowls with a well of melted butter and dusting of cinnamon

recipes.name: Gata
recipes.description: Flaky sweet pastry with buttery sugar filling.
ingredients: Filling: 1 cup flour, 1 cup sugar, 100g butter
instructions: Mix dough ingredients
Make filling by crumbling flour, sugar, butter
Roll dough, spread filling, roll up
Shape into round, score top, brush with egg
Bake at 180°C 35 min

recipes.name: Su Börek
recipes.description: Layers of boiled pasta and cheese filling — brought to Armenia from the Ottoman tradition. The boiled pasta layer makes it uniquely soft and custard-like.
instructions: Boil pasta sheets briefly, lay on damp towels
Mix cheeses with eggs and parsley
Layer: buttered pan, pasta, cheese mixture, pasta, cheese, pasta — repeat
Top layer should be pasta, brushed generously with butter and milk
Bake at 180°C for 30-35 min until golden
Let rest 10 min before cutting into squares

recipes.name: Lahmajun
recipes.description: Paper-thin flatbread covered in spiced raw lamb and flash-baked until the meat is cooked and the bread is crispy yet pliable. Squeeze lemon and roll it up. The viral appeal is the speed (6 minutes in a scorching oven) and the satisfying roll-up-and-bite technique. A beloved Armenian street food with ancient roots.
ingredients: Dough: 3 cups flour, yeast, water, salt, olive oil
Topping: 300g minced lamb, 2 tomatoes (finely diced), 1 onion (finely diced), parsley, red pepper paste, cumin, Aleppo pepper, lemon juice
Fresh lemon wedges, fresh herbs for serving
instructions: Make thin, pliable dough — let rise 30 min
Divide into balls, roll paper-thin — almost translucent
Spread a thin layer of the raw lamb-tomato-spice mixture over entire surface
Bake at highest oven temperature (250°C+) for 6-8 min — the bread crisps, the lamb cooks
The bread should be thin and slightly charred at edges but still pliable enough to roll
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the hot lahmajun
Roll up like a wrap or fold in half
Eat immediately — the crispy-pliable contrast fades quickly
Armenians and Turks both claim this — but the Armenian version is thinner and more lemony

imageCredit.author: No machine-readable author provided. Rainer Zenz assumed (based on copyright claims).

recipes.name: Pakhlava
recipes.description: Armenian baklava with walnuts, cardamom, and honey.
ingredients: Syrup: 2 cups sugar, 1 cup water, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions: Layer phyllo with butter and nut mixture
Cut into diamonds before baking
Bake at 170°C 40 min
Make syrup, pour warm over hot baklava
Soak several hours

recipes.name: Gata
recipes.description: Armenian sweet bread with a crumbly butter-sugar filling called khoriz. Bakeries shape them in elaborate patterns.
ingredients: Dough: flour, butter, yogurt, yeast, sugar, egg
Khoriz filling: flour, butter, sugar (mixed to crumbly texture)
instructions: Make enriched dough, let rise
Make khoriz: mix flour with softened butter and sugar until crumbly
Roll dough, spread with khoriz, fold and roll again
Shape into rounds or braids
Brush with egg wash, sprinkle sesame seeds
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 min until golden

recipes.name: Sujukh
recipes.description: Walnut strings coated in thickened grape must — the Armenian candy, cured for weeks and sliced into chewy rounds.
instructions: Thread walnuts onto strings using a needle
Cook grape juice with flour, sugar, and spices until thick and glossy
Dip walnut strings into the thickened grape mixture
Hang to dry 1-2 hours
Dip again — repeat 3-4 times until coating is thick
Hang in cool dry place for 1-2 weeks to firm up
Slice into rounds to serve

recipes.name: Tan
recipes.description: Refreshing salted yogurt drink.
instructions: Whisk yogurt smooth
Add water gradually
Season with salt
Serve over ice with mint

recipes.name: Tuti Oghi
recipes.description: Traditional Armenian fruit brandy.
instructions: Crush mulberries
Ferment 2-3 weeks
Strain and distill
Age 6+ months

recipes.name: Tan
recipes.description: Armenian salty yogurt drink — the universal BBQ companion. Called 'tan' and drunk by the pitcher.
instructions: Whisk yogurt until smooth
Add cold water gradually, whisk until frothy
Season with salt
Serve cold — the perfect accompaniment to khorovats

recipes.name: Armenian Coffee
recipes.description: Armenians call it Armenian coffee (not Turkish). The ritual of reading fortunes from the grounds is a beloved tradition.
instructions: Add coffee, sugar, and cold water to jezve (long-handled pot)
Stir to dissolve
Place on low heat — do not stir once it starts heating
Watch carefully — when foam begins to rise, remove from heat immediately
Let foam settle slightly, return to heat — repeat 2-3 times
Pour gently into demitasse cups, foam first
Let grounds settle 1-2 min before sipping

recipes.name: Avocado on Toast
recipes.description: Yes, it's a global meme, but Australia really did start it — Melbourne cafés in the 2010s made it a worldwide phenomenon.
instructions: Toast sourdough until golden and crunchy
Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt
Spread thickly on toast
Top with pepper flakes, flaky salt
Add poached egg and crumbled feta if desired

recipes.name: Vegemite on Toast
recipes.description: The national taste — salty, yeasty, polarizing. Australians learn to love it as children and defend it for life.
instructions: Toast bread
Spread generously with butter while still hot
Apply a thin scrape of Vegemite — thick if you're brave
The butter must melt into the toast before the Vegemite goes on

recipes.name: Bacon and Egg Roll
recipes.description: The Saturday morning staple from every corner bakery and servo across the country.
instructions: Fry bacon until edges crisp
Fry eggs in bacon fat
Butter rolls
Stack bacon and egg in each roll
Add sauce — the 'barbie sauce vs tomato sauce' debate is ongoing

recipes.name: Meat Pie
recipes.description: Australia's unofficial national dish. Four'n Twenty pies outsell everything, but a good bakery pie is sacred.
instructions: Brown mince with onion
Stir in flour, cook 1 min
Add stock, tomato paste, Worcestershire, Vegemite
Simmer 20 min until thick — filling should be saucy, not dry
Line pie tins with shortcrust, fill
Top with puff pastry, egg wash
Bake at 200°C for 25-30 min until puffed and golden
Eat with tomato sauce, ideally at the footy

recipes.name: Barramundi Fish and Chips
recipes.description: Barramundi is the quintessential Australian fish — firm, sweet, perfect for battering.
ingredients: Beer batter: 1 cup flour, 200ml cold beer, 1 egg, salt
instructions: Cut potatoes into thick chips, soak in water 30 min
Dry chips, fry at 140°C until soft, drain, then fry at 190°C until crispy
Make batter: whisk flour, beer, egg, salt — should be lumpy, not smooth
Pat fish dry, dust with flour
Dip in batter, lower into 190°C oil
Fry 4-5 min until deep golden
Drain, serve with chips, lemon, tartare

recipes.name: Chicken Parmigiana
recipes.description: Every pub in Australia serves a parmi. The great 'parma vs parmi' pronunciation debate divides states.
instructions: Crumb chicken: flour, egg, breadcrumbs
Fry until golden both sides
Place on baking tray
Top with napolitana sauce, ham, mozzarella
Bake at 200°C until cheese melts and bubbles, 10-12 min
Serve with chips and garden salad — always

recipes.name: BBQ Lamb Chops
recipes.description: The Australian BBQ is backyard culture. Lamb chops are the weeknight default.
instructions: Rub chops with oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, pepper
Get the barbie screaming hot
Grill 3-4 min per side for medium — Australians like them pink
Rest 5 min
Serve with mint sauce and roast vegetables

recipes.name: Roast Lamb Leg with Gravy
recipes.description: The Australian Sunday roast — lamb outsells beef here. Leftovers become Monday's lamb sandwiches.
instructions: Stud lamb leg with garlic slivers and rosemary
Rub with oil, salt heavily
Roast at 220°C for 20 min, then 160°C for 90 min
Add potatoes and carrots around the lamb at the hour mark
Rest lamb 20 min, tented in foil
Make gravy from pan drippings: add flour, stir, add stock, simmer
Carve and serve with roast vegetables and gravy

recipes.name: Kangaroo Steak with Native Pepperberry
recipes.description: Lean, gamey, and sustainably harvested — kangaroo is gaining pride of place on modern Australian menus.
ingredients: Native pepperberry (or black pepper and juniper)
Red wine jus: 200ml red wine, 200ml beef stock, butter
instructions: Bring steaks to room temperature
Season with salt, crushed pepperberry, garlic
Sear in very hot pan 2 min per side — kangaroo MUST be rare to medium-rare, it toughens when overcooked
Rest 5 min
Deglaze pan with red wine, reduce by half
Add stock, reduce, mount with butter
Slice against grain, serve over sweet potato mash with jus

recipes.name: Sausage Sizzle
recipes.description: The Bunnings sausage sizzle: cheap white bread, a snag, onions, and sauce. Found outside every hardware store on weekends.
instructions: Cook sausages on flat BBQ plate — snags should be brown all over
Slowly caramelize sliced onions in butter on same plate
Place sausage diagonally on a slice of white bread
Top with onions
Add tomato sauce — diagonal stripe, naturally
Fold bread over and eat with one hand

recipes.name: Damper
recipes.description: Bush bread from the droving days — stockmen baked it in campfire ashes. Still made at every school camp.
instructions: Mix flour and salt, rub in butter
Add milk, stir to sticky dough — don't overwork
Shape into round loaf on floured tray
Score a cross on top
Bake at 200°C for 25-30 min until hollow-sounding when tapped
Tear chunks and eat with butter or golden syrup

recipes.name: Fairy Bread
recipes.description: Buttered white bread covered in rainbow sprinkles — Australia's most beloved party food. Every child's birthday has it. Went viral globally when non-Australians discovered adults eat it too. The simplicity IS the point.
ingredients: Hundreds and thousands (round rainbow sprinkles — NOT jimmies or nonpareils)
instructions: Butter each slice of bread generously
Press buttered side firmly into a plate of hundreds and thousands
The sprinkles must be the round type — this is non-negotiable in Australia
Cut diagonally into triangles
Serve on a platter — no one takes just one

recipes.name: Chicken Salt Chips
recipes.description: Hot chips dusted with chicken salt — a uniquely Australian obsession. The bright yellow seasoning went viral when the rest of the world realized Australia has its own chip seasoning and it's on everything.
ingredients: Chicken salt (a bright yellow seasoned salt — not actual chicken, it's a uniquely Australian spice blend of garlic, onion, paprika, and chicken flavoring)
instructions: Fry chips until golden and crispy
Toss immediately with chicken salt while hot — be generous
Serve in paper, standing up, at the beach or the footy

recipes.name: Tim Tam Slam
recipes.description: The Tim Tam Slam — using Australia's iconic chocolate biscuit as a straw for hot drinks. Went massively viral worldwide. The 2-second window between 'perfectly melted' and 'collapsed into your mug' is the thrill.
instructions: Bite off both diagonal corners of the Tim Tam
Use the Tim Tam as a straw — suck hot drink through it
The hot liquid melts the chocolate interior into a molten mess
When you feel it start to collapse, shove the entire thing in your mouth
The result is a warm, melting, collapsing chocolate bomb

recipes.name: Pavlova
recipes.description: Named for ballerina Anna Pavlova. Australia and New Zealand both claim it — the rivalry is real and ongoing.
instructions: Beat egg whites to stiff peaks
Add sugar gradually, beating until glossy and thick
Fold in vinegar, cornflour, vanilla
Shape into round on lined tray — crater the center slightly
Bake at 120°C for 90 min, then turn off oven and leave inside to cool completely
Top with whipped cream
Pile with passionfruit pulp, sliced strawberries, kiwi

recipes.name: Lamingtons
recipes.description: The iconic Australian cake — sponge cubes dipped in chocolate and rolled in coconut. January 21st is National Lamington Day.
ingredients: Sponge: 4 eggs, ¾ cup sugar, 1 cup flour, butter, milk
Chocolate icing: 3 cups icing sugar, ⅓ cup cocoa, 50g butter, ½ cup milk
instructions: Make vanilla sponge, bake at 180°C in square tin
Cool completely, refrigerate overnight for easier cutting
Cut into cubes (about 5cm)
Make chocolate icing: mix icing sugar, cocoa, melted butter, warm milk until smooth and runny
Dip each cube in chocolate using two forks
Roll immediately in coconut
Set on wire rack to dry

recipes.name: Golden Gaytime Ice Cream Crumble
recipes.description: Golden Gaytime — Australia's cult-favorite ice cream bar, deconstructed into a dessert. The honeycomb biscuit coating is the viral element. 'You can't have a Gaytime on your own' is the actual slogan.
ingredients: 6 Golden Gaytime ice cream bars (toffee and vanilla ice cream, honeycomb biscuit crumbs)
instructions: Chop Golden Gaytime bars into chunks
Layer in serving glasses: ice cream chunks, cream, caramel, biscuit crumbs
Repeat layers
Top with extra honeycomb crumbs from the Gaytime coating
Serve immediately — it melts fast

recipes.name: Flat White
recipes.description: Born in 1980s Australia (or New Zealand — another dispute). Stronger and less milky than a latte, now a worldwide staple.
ingredients: Steamed milk (less foam than a latte, microfoam only)
instructions: Pull a double espresso into a ceramic cup
Steam milk to create velvety microfoam — less airy than a cappuccino, silkier than a latte
Pour milk over espresso, creating a thin layer of microfoam on top
No latte art mountains — just a flat, white surface of microfoam

recipes.name: Lemon, Lime and Bitters
recipes.description: The non-alcoholic pub classic — every Australian kid grew up ordering an LLB at the bar.
instructions: Fill glass with ice
Dash Angostura bitters, swirl to coat glass
Add a splash of lime cordial
Top with lemonade
Garnish with lime slice

recipes.name: Lamingtons
recipes.description: Australian sponge cake coated in chocolate and coconut
ingredients: Sponge cake: 4 eggs, 1 cup sugar, 2 cups flour, 2 tsp baking powder
Chocolate coating: 1 cup cocoa, 1 cup sugar, 1 cup milk, 2 tbsp butter
instructions: Bake sponge cake from scratch at 350°F for 30 minutes
Cool completely
Cut into squares
Spread jam between layers if desired
Make chocolate sauce: combine cocoa, sugar, milk, butter, heat until smooth
Cool chocolate slightly
Dip each cake piece in chocolate
Roll in shredded coconut
Place on baking paper to set
Serve when chocolate hardens
recipes.fun_fact: Lamingtons are iconic Australian cake and are served at school fairs and celebrations

recipes.name: Australian Barbie
recipes.description: Classic Australian outdoor grilling with sausages and steak
instructions: Heat barbecue grill
Season meats with salt, pepper, oil
Grill sausages until golden and cooked through
Grill steak to desired doneness
Grill chicken until cooked through
Toast bread on grill
Grill onions
Serve with BBQ sauce
Pair with beer or soft drink
recipes.fun_fact: The 'barbie' is central to Australian culture and is held year-round

recipes.name: Meat Pie
recipes.description: Australian savory meat pie with gravy and pastry crust
ingredients: Pastry: 3 cups flour, 1 cup butter, 1/2 cup cold water
Filling: 2 lbs beef, 2 onions, 4 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 cup broth, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, Herbs
instructions: Make pastry: mix flour and salt, cut in butter, add water, chill
Brown meat with onion and garlic
Add tomato paste, broth, Worcestershire, herbs
Simmer 20 minutes until thick
Cool filling
Line pie dish with pastry
Add filling
Top with pastry
Cut vents
Brush with egg wash
Bake at 400°F for 35-40 minutes until golden
recipes.fun_fact: Meat pies are Australia's quintessential handheld meal and street food

recipes.name: ANZAC Biscuits
recipes.description: Australian oat cookies with honey and golden syrup
instructions: Mix oats, flour, coconut in bowl
Melt butter with golden syrup
Mix baking soda with hot water
Combine melted mixture with soda water
Add to dry ingredients
Drop spoonfuls on baking tray
Bake at 325°F for 15-20 minutes
Cool on tray briefly
Transfer to cooling rack
tips: Should be chewy inside, crispy outside
recipes.fun_fact: ANZAC biscuits were sent to soldiers in WWI and have been an Australian tradition ever since

recipes.name: Pavlova
recipes.description: Australian meringue base topped with whipped cream and fresh berries
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form
Gradually add sugar while beating
Add cornstarch, vinegar, vanilla
Spread or pipe into large circle on baking paper
Make slight indent in center
Bake at 250°F for 50-60 minutes until pale and crispy
Cool completely
Top with whipped cream
Arrange berries on top
Serve immediately
tips: Must cool completely before adding topping
recipes.fun_fact: Pavlova is claimed by both Australia and New Zealand and is iconic to both countries

recipes.name: Milo
recipes.description: Australian iconic chocolate malt drink
instructions: Add Milo powder to glass
Add small amount cold milk, stir to paste
Add hot or cold milk to fill glass
Stir well
Serve immediately
Can add ice for cold version
tips: Can be served hot or cold
recipes.fun_fact: Milo is an Australian institution and is served in schools and homes

recipes.name: Australian Beer
recipes.description: Australian lager served ice-cold
instructions: Serve in cold glass
Pour with head
Enjoy with barbecue food
Cheers
recipes.fun_fact: Australian beer culture is strong and beer is essential at any barbie

recipes.name: Kaiserschmarrn
recipes.description: Legend says Emperor Franz Joseph loved this torn-up pancake. Every ski hut and mountain restaurant in Austria serves it.
instructions: Beat yolks with milk, sugar, salt; stir in flour
Beat whites to stiff peaks, fold in gently — this is what makes it fluffy
Melt butter in skillet, pour in batter
Add raisins if using
Cook until bottom sets, tear into pieces with two forks
Keep tossing and turning pieces until golden and caramelized
Dust generously with powdered sugar
Serve with warm plum compote

recipes.name: Semmel mit Butter und Marmelade
recipes.description: The Austrian breakfast standard — a crusty roll, butter, and Wachau apricot jam. Eaten at every hotel breakfast table.
instructions: Slice Semmeln in half
Spread generously with butter
Top with apricot jam

recipes.name: Topfenpalatschinken
recipes.description: Delicate crêpes stuffed with sweetened curd cheese and baked until golden.
ingredients: Crêpes: 150g flour, 2 eggs, 250ml milk, pinch salt, butter
Filling: 500g Topfen (quark/curd cheese), 2 egg yolks, 60g sugar, lemon zest, vanilla, raisins
instructions: Make thin crêpes
Mix Topfen with yolks, sugar, lemon zest, vanilla, raisins
Fill each crêpe, roll up
Place in buttered baking dish, pour sour cream over
Bake at 180°C for 20 min
Dust with powdered sugar

recipes.name: Wiener Schnitzel
recipes.description: Vienna's gift to the world. Real Wiener Schnitzel is VEAL, never pork (that's Schnitzel Wiener Art). The coating must puff away from the meat.
ingredients: Clarified butter or lard for frying
instructions: Pound veal between plastic wrap until very thin and even
Season with salt only — never pepper on a Schnitzel
Dredge in flour, shake off excess
Dip in egg wash, let excess drip
Press into breadcrumbs — don't pack, keep it loose
Fry in plenty of hot fat — the Schnitzel must swim, not sit
Shake the pan constantly — this creates the signature wrinkly, puffy coating
Fry 2-3 min per side until deep golden
Drain briefly, serve immediately with lemon wedge
Parsley, lingonberry jam, and potato salad on the side

recipes.name: Tafelspitz
recipes.description: Emperor Franz Joseph's favorite meal, served daily at the Habsburg court. The test of a great Viennese cook.
ingredients: Accompaniments: apple-horseradish sauce, chive sauce, roasted potatoes
instructions: Place bones in cold water, bring to boil, skim thoroughly
Add charred onion, peppercorns, bay leaf
After 1 hour, add the beef in one piece
Simmer very gently — never boil — for 2 hours
Add root vegetables in the last 45 min
Meat is done when a fork slides in and out easily
Slice against the grain, arrange on warm platter with vegetables
Serve in broth, with apple-horseradish and chive sauce alongside
Ladle some broth over the meat at the table

recipes.name: Frittatensuppe
recipes.description: The classic first course of any Austrian Sunday lunch — delicate crêpe strips floating in crystal-clear beef broth.
ingredients: Crêpes: 2 eggs, 100g flour, 150ml milk, salt, butter
instructions: Make thin crêpes, let cool
Roll each crêpe up tightly
Slice into thin strips (Frittaten)
Heat beef broth until piping hot
Place a nest of crêpe strips in each bowl
Ladle hot broth over
Scatter with chives

recipes.name: Backhendl
recipes.description: Fried chicken, Austrian-style — crumbed like a Schnitzel. Predates American fried chicken by centuries.
instructions: Season chicken with salt, rest 10 min
Coat in flour, egg, breadcrumbs — same technique as Schnitzel
Fry in plenty of hot fat, turning occasionally
Cook 12-15 min until deep golden and cooked through
Fry parsley sprigs briefly until crispy
Drain chicken on wire rack
Serve with lemon and fried parsley

recipes.name: Schweinsbraten
recipes.description: Austrian-style pork roast with caraway and crackling — the Sunday dinner across Gasthaus kitchens.
instructions: Score the skin in a diamond pattern
Rub salt and caraway into the cuts, stud with garlic
Place on rack in roasting pan with onion and beer
Roast at 180°C for 2 hours, basting with pan juices
Last 20 min, increase to 220°C for crackling
The skin should be shattering-crisp, the meat tender
Let rest 15 min
Serve with sauerkraut and bread dumplings, ladle pan juices over

recipes.name: Kaspressknödel
recipes.description: Tyrolean cheese dumplings — pressed flat and fried golden, served in broth or on salad in every mountain hut.
instructions: Soak bread in milk until soft
Mix with eggs, cheese, sautéed onion, parsley, seasoning
Shape into thick patties (not balls)
Fry in butter until golden on both sides, 4 min per side
Serve floating in clear broth, or on a green salad with vinaigrette

recipes.name: Leberkäse-Semmel
recipes.description: Austria's ubiquitous snack — a thick slab of warm meatloaf in a crusty roll with mustard. Bought from every Fleischerei and market stand.
instructions: Slice Leberkäse thick from the loaf — ideally fresh from the oven with a crispy top
Split Semmel
Place Leberkäse inside
Add mustard — the sweet Bavarian type is traditional

recipes.name: Brezn
