recipes.description: Light, golden fried dough.
instructions: Mix dough, rise 1 hour
Shape into balls, flatten slightly
Deep fry until golden
Serve with beans or on their own

recipes.name: Soya
recipes.description: Charcoal-grilled spiced beef skewers — Cameroon's beloved roadside snack, found wherever there's a grill and a crowd.
ingredients: Suya spice: peanut powder, chili, ginger, onion powder, garlic, salt
instructions: Thread seasoned beef onto skewers
Grill over charcoal, basting with oil
Serve with onion slices, cabbage, and extra suya spice

recipes.name: Puff-Puff
recipes.description: West Africa's most famous street snack — fluffy fried dough balls that are the continent's answer to beignets. The hand-scooping technique and the perfect golden puff have made puff-puff one of the most viral African street food videos on social media.
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, salt, nutmeg, yeast
Add warm water gradually — batter should be thick but scoopable, not a dough
Cover and let rise 1-2 hours until doubled and bubbly
Heat oil to 170°C
Scoop batter with wet hands or spoon, drop into oil
Fry until deep golden brown, turning once — 3-4 min
Drain on paper
Dust with powdered sugar or eat plain
These must be eaten warm — the inside is fluffy, the outside crispy

recipes.name: Banana Flambe
recipes.description: Caramelized bananas flambéed in rum.
instructions: Slice bananas lengthwise
Melt butter, add sugar
Cook bananas until caramelized
Add rum, ignite carefully
Spoon over ice cream

recipes.name: Caramel Cake
recipes.description: Caramel-topped sponge cake — French-Cameroonian patisserie tradition, served at celebrations and Sunday gatherings.
instructions: Make caramel: cook sugar until amber, pour into cake mold
Make batter: cream butter and remaining sugar, add eggs, flour, milk, vanilla, baking powder
Pour batter over caramel
Bake at 175°C for 30-35 min
Invert while warm — caramel sauce cascades down
Cool before slicing

imageCredit.author: No machine-readable author provided. Rainer Zenz assumed (based on copyright claims).

recipes.name: Folere
recipes.description: Tart ruby hibiscus drink with ginger.
instructions: Boil hibiscus and ginger 10 min
Strain, sweeten
Chill, serve with mint

recipes.name: Palm Wine
recipes.description: Fresh, mildly alcoholic palm sap.
instructions: Tap palm tree for sap
Collect in calabash
Let ferment naturally 4-8 hours
Serve same day while fresh

recipes.name: Matango
recipes.description: Fresh palm sap from the raphia palm — tapped daily and drunk the same day. Sweet in the morning, boozy by evening, vinegar by tomorrow.
instructions: Tap the raphia palm trunk or flower stalk
Collect sap in a calabash — it's already mildly alcoholic
Drink fresh the same day for sweet, slightly fizzy taste
By evening it ferments stronger
By the next day it's vinegar — timing is everything

recipes.name: Eggs Benedict
recipes.description: A dish with strong Canadian roots — back bacon instead of ham is the Canadian hallmark. Weekend brunch across the country.
ingredients: Hollandaise: 3 egg yolks, 150g butter (clarified), lemon juice, cayenne, salt
instructions: Make hollandaise: whisk yolks over double boiler, slowly drizzle in clarified butter, add lemon juice, cayenne, salt
Fry back bacon until lightly browned
Poach eggs: bring water to gentle simmer with vinegar, swirl, slip eggs in, cook 3 min
Toast muffin halves
Stack: muffin, bacon, poached egg
Spoon hollandaise over — it should be thick enough to coat but still flow

recipes.name: Crêpes au Sirop d'Érable
recipes.full_name: Crêpes au Sirop d'Érable (Maple Syrup Crêpes)
recipes.description: Thin French-Canadian crêpes swimming in Quebec maple syrup — the sweetest breakfast in the country.
instructions: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, melted butter, salt into thin batter
Rest 10 min
Heat buttered crêpe pan, pour thin layer of batter
Cook until edges lift, flip, cook 30 sec more
Stack crêpes, drizzle generously with maple syrup
Top with whipped cream and berries

recipes.name: Bannock
recipes.description: Indigenous bread — made for centuries by First Nations peoples across Canada. Baked or fried, always warm, always shared.
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, sugar
Cut in butter until crumbly
Add water, stir to form soft dough — don't overwork
Shape into rounds or one large flat disc
Bake at 190°C for 20-25 min, or fry in oil until golden on both sides
Serve warm with butter, jam, or honey

recipes.name: Poutine
recipes.description: Quebec's gift to the world — crispy fries, squeaky cheese curds, hot gravy. The curds must squeak when you bite them; that's how you know they're fresh.
ingredients: Gravy: 2 cups beef stock, 2 tbsp butter, 2 tbsp flour, pepper, salt
instructions: Cut potatoes into thick fries, soak in cold water 30 min, dry thoroughly
Fry at 150°C for 5 min (blanch), drain, fry again at 190°C until golden and crispy
Make gravy: melt butter, whisk in flour, cook 2 min, add stock, simmer until thickened
Place hot fries in bowl
Scatter cheese curds — they MUST be room temperature and squeaky
Ladle hot gravy over — it partially melts the curds
Eat immediately — poutine waits for no one

recipes.name: Montreal Smoked Meat Sandwich
recipes.description: Montreal's answer to the deli sandwich — peppery, smoky brisket piled on rye. Schwartz's has served them since 1928.
instructions: The brisket has been cured with salt, pepper, coriander, garlic for 10 days, then smoked
Steam the smoked meat for 3-4 hours until incredibly tender
Slice by hand — thick or thin, your call (medium is classic)
Pile high on rye bread — at least 200g per sandwich
Add yellow mustard only — nothing else
Serve with a full dill pickle on the side

recipes.name: Tourtière
recipes.description: French-Canadian meat pie — mandatory at Christmas Eve réveillon. Every Québécois family guards their spice ratio.
ingredients: Pastry: 500g flour, 250g butter or lard, cold water, salt
Filling: 500g ground pork, 250g ground veal, 1 onion, 2 potatoes (diced small), cinnamon, cloves, allspice, sage, salt, pepper, 200ml beef broth
instructions: Make pastry: cut butter into flour and salt, add cold water, form dough, chill 30 min
Sauté onion, add meats, brown, break up
Add diced potato, spices, broth
Simmer until potato is tender and liquid absorbed — filling should be moist but not wet
Cool filling
Line pie dish with pastry, fill, top with pastry lid, crimp edges, cut steam vents
Bake at 200°C for 35-40 min until golden

recipes.name: Butter Tart-Glazed Salmon
recipes.description: Pacific or Atlantic salmon with a maple-mustard glaze — Canada's two coasts meet in one dish.
ingredients: Glaze: 2 tbsp butter, 3 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, lemon juice
instructions: Season salmon with salt and pepper
Make glaze: melt butter, whisk in maple syrup, soy, mustard, lemon
Sear salmon skin-side down in hot pan 4 min
Flip, brush with glaze
Finish in 200°C oven for 8-10 min, brushing glaze twice more
Garnish with dill

recipes.name: Alberta Beef Stew
recipes.description: Hearty prairie stew — Alberta beef slow-cooked with root vegetables and stout. Made for cold Canadian winters.
instructions: Toss beef in flour, brown in batches in hot oil
Sauté onion and garlic
Add tomato paste, cook 2 min
Deglaze with stout
Add broth, thyme, bay leaf, return beef
Simmer covered 60 min
Add potatoes, carrots, parsnips
Cook 45 more min until everything is falling-apart tender
Season generously

recipes.name: Jiggs Dinner
recipes.description: Newfoundland's Sunday dinner — salt beef boiled with root vegetables. The whole island smells of it on Sunday afternoon.
ingredients: 1 salt beef pudding bag or pease pudding (split yellow peas in cheesecloth)
instructions: Simmer salt beef in fresh water for 2 hours
Add turnip and pease pudding bag, cook 30 min
Add carrots and potatoes, cook 20 min
Add cabbage, cook 15 min
Everything cooks in the same pot in stages
Serve on a big platter with drawn butter on the side
The pease pudding is mashed and served alongside

recipes.name: BeaverTails
recipes.description: Flat fried pastry stretched into a beaver-tail shape — an Ottawa original, sold at every winter festival and skating rink.
ingredients: Toppings: cinnamon sugar, Nutella, maple butter, lemon and sugar
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, sugar
Cut in butter, add milk, form dough
Divide into balls, stretch each into a long flat oval (beaver tail shape)
Deep fry 1-2 min per side until golden and puffy
Top with cinnamon sugar (classic) or other toppings

recipes.name: Nanaimo Bars
recipes.description: Three-layer no-bake bars from Nanaimo, BC — chocolate crumb, custard cream, chocolate ganache. No Canadian bake sale is complete without them.
ingredients: Base: 1/2 cup butter, 1/4 cup sugar, 5 tbsp cocoa, 1 egg, 2 cups graham crumbs, 1 cup coconut, 1/2 cup walnuts
Middle: 1/4 cup butter, 2 tbsp custard powder, 2 cups powdered sugar, 3 tbsp cream
instructions: Base: melt butter with sugar and cocoa over double boiler, add egg, stir until thick, mix in crumbs, coconut, walnuts, press into 9x9 pan
Chill 10 min
Middle: cream butter, custard powder, sugar, cream until fluffy, spread over base
Chill 10 min
Top: melt chocolate with butter, spread over middle layer
Chill until set, cut into bars

recipes.name: Poutine
recipes.description: Quebec's gift to the world — the unholy trinity of crispy fries, squeaky cheese curds, and hot gravy. The cheese must squeak when you bite it. Viral poutine debates (is it just cheesy fries? No.) and extreme poutine variations are a permanent fixture of food internet.
ingredients: Rich gravy: beef stock, butter, flour, pepper, splash of vinegar
instructions: Cut potatoes into thick fries, soak in cold water 30 min, dry thoroughly
Fry at 150°C for 5 min (blanch), rest, then fry at 190°C until golden and crispy
Make gravy: melt butter, whisk in flour, add hot beef stock, season, simmer until thick
Cheese curds must be at room temperature — cold curds won't melt right
Layer: hot fries, then curds (the heat starts melting them), then hot gravy over everything
The curds should be squeaky and half-melted — fully melted is wrong, unmelted is wrong
Eat immediately — poutine waits for no one

recipes.name: Butter Tarts
recipes.description: The great Canadian pastry — gooey brown sugar filling in flaky pastry. Raisins or no raisins divides the nation more than politics.
ingredients: Pastry: 250g flour, 150g cold butter, pinch salt, cold water
Filling: 1 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup corn syrup, 2 eggs, 2 tbsp butter (melted), 1 tsp vanilla, 1 tsp vinegar, pinch salt
Raisins or pecans (optional — this is a contentious issue)
instructions: Make pastry, chill 30 min, roll, cut rounds, line tart pans
Mix filling: whisk brown sugar, corn syrup, eggs, melted butter, vanilla, vinegar, salt
Add raisins or pecans if you dare (or leave plain — Canadians argue about this)
Fill tart shells two-thirds full
Bake at 230°C for 12-15 min until pastry is golden and filling is set but still slightly wobbly in the center
Cool — the filling firms as it cools

recipes.name: Pouding Chômeur
recipes.description: Depression-era Quebec dessert — cake batter baked in maple cream sauce. It inverts itself in the oven. Impossibly rich and humble at the same time.
ingredients: Cake: 1 cup flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 cup butter, 1/2 cup sugar, 1 egg, 1/2 cup milk, vanilla
Sauce: 1.5 cups maple syrup, 1 cup cream
instructions: Make cake batter: cream butter and sugar, add egg, alternate flour with milk
Pour batter into greased baking dish
Heat maple syrup and cream together — do NOT mix into batter
Pour hot syrup-cream mixture OVER the batter gently
Bake at 175°C for 30-35 min — the cake rises through the sauce
The sauce ends up on the bottom, the cake on top
Serve warm, spooning sauce from the bottom over each portion

recipes.name: Nanaimo Bars
recipes.description: A no-bake three-layer bar from Nanaimo, BC — chocolate-coconut-nut base, custard buttercream middle, chocolate ganache top. The cross-section reveal videos are perpetually viral, and the 'is it a cookie or a dessert' debate never ends.
ingredients: Base: 1/2 cup butter, 1/4 cup sugar, 5 tbsp cocoa, 1 egg, 2 cups graham cracker crumbs, 1 cup coconut, 1/2 cup walnuts
Middle: 1/4 cup butter, 2 cups icing sugar, 2 tbsp custard powder, 3 tbsp cream
Top: 4 oz semi-sweet chocolate, 2 tbsp butter
instructions: Base: melt butter, sugar, cocoa over double boiler, stir in egg, add crumbs, coconut, walnuts, press into 9x9 pan, chill
Middle: cream butter, add icing sugar, custard powder, cream — spread over base, chill
Top: melt chocolate and butter, spread over middle layer, chill until set but not hard
Score into bars while chocolate is slightly soft
Refrigerate until firm, cut into bars
Named after Nanaimo, British Columbia — every Canadian has an opinion about the best version

recipes.name: Caesar
recipes.description: Canada's national cocktail — invented in Calgary in 1969. Like a Bloody Mary but with clam-tomato juice. Canadians drink 400 million a year.
ingredients: Garnish: celery stalk, pickle, bacon, whatever you like
instructions: Rim glass with celery salt and lime
Fill with ice
Add vodka, hot sauce, Worcestershire
Fill with Clamato juice
Stir gently
Garnish with celery stalk — or go wild with pickles, bacon, shrimp, a whole burger (yes, this happens)

recipes.name: Caribou
recipes.description: Quebec's winter warmer — red wine, rye whisky, and maple syrup. Served at Quebec City's Carnaval from communal canes. Dangerously good in the cold.
instructions: Heat wine with spices and orange peel — do not boil
Add maple syrup
Add rye whisky off heat
Serve hot in mugs

recipes.name: Poutine
recipes.description: Canadian comfort food of crispy fries smothered in rich gravy and cheese curds
instructions: Cut potatoes into fries
Heat oil to 375°F
Fry potatoes in batches until golden
Drain on paper towels, season with salt
Make gravy: melt butter, whisk in flour
Add beef broth slowly while whisking
Simmer 5 minutes until thickened
Season with salt and pepper
Layer fries in container
Top with cheese curds
Pour hot gravy over
Serve immediately
tips: Gravy must be hot to slightly melt cheese curds
recipes.fun_fact: Poutine originated in Quebec and is now a Canadian icon

recipes.name: Butter Tarts
recipes.description: Canadian sweet tarts with gooey butter filling and raisins
instructions: Line tartlet tins with pie crust
Cream butter and brown sugar
Add egg and vanilla
Stir in raisins and salt
Fill shells halfway with filling
Bake at 350°F for 15-20 minutes
Filling should be bubbly but not overcooked
Cool slightly before removing from tins
tips: The gooey center is essential to authentic butter tarts
recipes.fun_fact: Butter tarts are a beloved Canadian dessert, often served at fairs and celebrations

recipes.name: Tourtière
recipes.description: Traditional French-Canadian meat pie with ground pork and spices
instructions: Line pie pan with dough
Brown pork with onion and garlic
Add broth and spices
Simmer 10 minutes until liquid reduces
Cool mixture
Fill pie shell
Top with dough, seal edges
Brush with egg wash
Cut vents
Bake at 375°F for 45-50 minutes until golden
recipes.fun_fact: Tourtière is a French-Canadian Christmas tradition

recipes.name: Poutine
recipes.description: Quebec's iconic dish - crispy fries with gravy and squeaky cheese curds
ingredients: 200g fresh cheese curds (or mozzarella if unavailable)
For gravy: 3 tablespoons butter, 3 tablespoons flour, 500ml beef stock, 1 tablespoon tomato paste, 1 onion diced, 2 cloves garlic minced, 1 bay leaf, salt and pepper
instructions: Make gravy first: melt butter in saucepan over medium heat
Add diced onion, cook 3 minutes until softened
Add minced garlic, cook 1 minute
Sprinkle flour over onion and garlic, stir constantly for 2 minutes to create roux
Gradually add beef stock, whisking to avoid lumps
Add tomato paste and bay leaf
Simmer 15 minutes until thickened, season with salt and pepper
Remove bay leaf, keep gravy warm
Meanwhile, cut potatoes into thick fries (about 1/2 inch thick)
Soak cut potatoes in cold water 30 minutes (removes starch for crispier fries)
Heat oil to 325°F (160°C)
First fry: cook potatoes in batches 10 minutes until partially cooked but not brown; drain
Increase oil temperature to 375°F (190°C)
Second fry: cook pre-fried potatoes in batches 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy; drain on paper towels
Season hot fries generously with salt
Place hot fries in serving container
Top with cheese curds (they should start to soften from heat)
Pour hot gravy over fries and cheese
Serve immediately while hot and crispy
tips: Fresh cheese curds are essential - they have a squeaky texture when properly made. Two-stage frying creates the perfect fry
recipes.fun_fact: Poutine originated in rural Quebec in the 1950s and has become a symbol of Quebec culture

recipes.name: Maple Taffy on Snow
recipes.description: Canadian maple candy made by pouring hot maple syrup on clean snow
instructions: Heat maple syrup to 235°F (soft-ball stage)
Add butter
Pack clean snow or shaved ice in pan or on clean surface
Slowly pour hot syrup in thin ribbons on snow
Let cool for 1-2 minutes until it sets
Roll each piece around popsicle stick
Eat immediately
recipes.fun_fact: Maple Taffy on Snow is a popular treat at Canadian sugar shacks
alternatives: Use frozen beet juice for colored version

recipes.name: Beavertails
recipes.description: Deep-fried pastry shaped like beaver tail, served with sweet toppings
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt
Add water to form dough
Let rest 20 minutes
Roll dough thin
Cut into oval beaver tail shapes
Heat oil to 350°F
Fry until golden on both sides
Drain on paper towels
Dust with cinnamon sugar
Serve warm with chocolate or maple syrup
tips: Dough should be thin and crispy when fried
recipes.fun_fact: Beavertails are a Canadian pastry found at Canadian fairs and events

recipes.name: Caesar Cocktail
recipes.description: Canadian drink with Clamato juice and spices, virgin version without alcohol
instructions: Fill glass with ice
Add Clamato juice, Worcestershire, hot sauce
Stir well
Salt and pepper rim
Garnish with celery stick
Serve with lime wedge
recipes.fun_fact: Caesars are so popular in Canada that some say more Caesars are consumed there than Bloody Marys in the US

recipes.name: Canadian Whisky
recipes.description: Light, smooth Canadian whisky often made from corn base, served on rocks or neat
instructions: Pour 1.5 oz into glass
Add ice or serve neat
Sip slowly
Enjoy the smooth character
tips: Lighter and smoother than American bourbon
recipes.fun_fact: Canadian whisky is known for its smooth, accessible taste

imageCredit.author: Original uploader was Hammersbach  at en.wikipedia

recipes.name: Bouillie
recipes.description: Warm millet porridge with peanut paste.
instructions: Boil water
Stir in millet flour gradually
Cook until thick, about 10 min
Top with peanut paste and sugar

recipes.name: Fried Plantains with Eggs
recipes.description: Simple breakfast of fried plantains and eggs.
instructions: Slice and fry plantains until golden
Scramble eggs
Serve together

recipes.name: Cassava Bread with Coffee
recipes.description: Simple cassava flatbread with sweet French-style coffee — the Central African morning routine.
instructions: Press and dry grated cassava
Shape into flat discs
Griddle until firm and slightly toasted on both sides
Serve with sweet coffee made with condensed milk

recipes.name: Kanda
recipes.description: Savory meatballs in peanut-greens sauce.
instructions: Mix ground beef with minced onion, shape into balls
Make sauce with tomato paste, peanut butter, palm oil
Simmer meatballs in sauce 20 min
Add greens, cook 10 min
Serve with cassava

recipes.name: Gozo
recipes.description: Thick, stretchy cassava paste.
ingredients: Peanut sauce or fish stew for serving
instructions: Boil water
Add cassava flour gradually, stirring hard
Cook until very thick and stretchy
Mold into ball
Serve with sauce or stew

recipes.name: Ngali
recipes.description: Sesame-thickened stew — sesame grows widely in the Central African Republic and gives this sauce its distinctive nutty richness.
instructions: Toast and grind sesame seeds
Brown meat with onion
Add tomato, palm oil
Dissolve ground sesame in water, add to pot
Add greens
Simmer 25 min until thick and rich
Serve with gozo or rice

recipes.name: Mafé
recipes.description: Rich peanut stew with chicken and root vegetables.
instructions: Brown chicken, set aside
Sauté onions, garlic, tomatoes
Add peanut butter and water
Return chicken, add carrots and sweet potato
Simmer 35 min until tender
Serve with rice

recipes.name: Grilled Capitaine
recipes.description: Charcoal-grilled Nile perch with onions.
instructions: Marinate fish with lemon, garlic, chili
Grill over charcoal until flaky
Sauté onion rings
Serve fish topped with onions
Accompany with fried plantains

recipes.name: Capitaine Braisé
recipes.description: Pan-fried river fish in spicy tomato sauce — caught from the Ubangi and Chari rivers.
ingredients: Marinade: lime, garlic, ginger, Maggi cube
instructions: Score fish, marinate in lime, garlic, ginger
Fry until crispy on both sides
Make sauce: cook onion and tomato until thick
Simmer fish in sauce 10 min
Serve with fried plantains

recipes.name: Gozo
recipes.description: The Central African Republic's essential meal — a smooth cassava dumpling dome served with a rich peanut-and-dried-fish sauce. The vigorous stirring technique and the communal eating style have caught attention from food creators exploring Central African cuisine.
ingredients: Peanut sauce: ground peanuts, tomatoes, onion, garlic, palm oil, dried fish, okra
instructions: Make gozo: bring water to boil, add cassava flour gradually, stir vigorously with wooden spoon
Keep stirring until thick, smooth, elastic — this is a workout
Shape into a dome on a plate
Make peanut sauce: fry onion and garlic in palm oil, add ground peanuts, tomatoes
Add dried fish and okra, simmer until thick
Season with chili and salt
Serve gozo with sauce poured around and over it
Eat with your right hand — pull off a piece of gozo, dip in sauce

recipes.name: Makara
recipes.description: Crispy bean fritters.
instructions: Blend beans with onion and chili
Season with salt
Fry spoonfuls in hot oil until golden

recipes.name: Brochettes de Chèvre
recipes.description: Charcoal-grilled goat skewers — sold at every roadside grill in Bangui, especially in the evening.
instructions: Marinate goat in ginger, garlic, salt, chili
Thread onto skewers with onion
Grill over charcoal
Serve with hot pepper sauce

recipes.name: Sweet Fried Plantains
recipes.description: Caramelized fried plantains as dessert.
instructions: Slice plantains
Fry until caramelized
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon

recipes.name: Coconut Rice Pudding
recipes.description: Simple coconut rice pudding — French colonial influence meets tropical ingredients.
instructions: Cook rice in coconut milk until very soft
Sweeten with sugar
Add cinnamon and vanilla
Serve warm or cold

recipes.name: Ginger Juice
recipes.description: Spicy, refreshing ginger drink.
instructions: Grate ginger, boil in water 10 min
Strain, add sugar and lemon
Chill and serve

recipes.name: Hydromel
recipes.description: Traditional honey mead.
instructions: Dissolve honey in warm water
Cool, add yeast
Ferment 2-3 weeks
Strain and bottle

recipes.name: Bissap
recipes.description: Deep red hibiscus drink — refreshing, tart, served at every celebration. Known across French-speaking Africa.
instructions: Boil hibiscus flowers 10 min
Strain
Add sugar, ginger juice
Cool, add mint
Serve very cold

recipes.name: Boule
recipes.description: Millet ball — Chad's daily staple.
instructions: Boil water
Stir in millet flour
Cook until thick
Form into balls
Serve with sauce

recipes.name: Beignets with Coffee
recipes.description: Fried dough with strong Chadian coffee.
instructions: Mix dough, rise 30 min
Fry until golden
Serve with sweetened coffee

recipes.name: Kawal Porridge
recipes.description: Millet porridge flavored with kawal — fermented leaves that give a powerful savory taste, unique to Chad and Sudan.
instructions: Cook millet porridge with water
Stir in kawal powder — it adds intense umami
Season with salt and a drizzle of peanut oil

recipes.name: Daraba
recipes.description: Thick okra stew with peanuts and dried fish.
instructions: Sauté onion and tomatoes
Add okra and water
Add peanut paste
Add dried fish, simmer 20 min

recipes.name: Kisra
recipes.description: Thin fermented sorghum crepe.
instructions: Mix flour with water to thin batter
Let ferment 12 hours
Pour thin layer on hot griddle
Cook until set, peel off
Serve with stew

recipes.name: Sauce Gombo
recipes.description: Slimy okra sauce over millet paste — the sliminess is the point, a valued texture across the Sahel.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in oil
Add tomato, cook until broken down
Add sliced okra
Add meat or dried fish with water
Simmer 20 min until okra is slimy and sauce is thick
Season
Serve over boule

recipes.name: La Bouillie
recipes.description: Rich meat stew with okra and peanuts.
instructions: Brown meat, add onions and tomatoes
Add water, simmer 40 min
Add okra and peanut paste
Cook 20 more min
Serve with boule

recipes.name: Grilled Fish
recipes.description: Wood-fire grilled whole fish.
instructions: Score fish, rub with garlic, chili, lemon, salt
Grill slowly over wood fire
Turn once, cook until charred and flaky
Serve with cassava

recipes.name: Jarret de Boeuf
recipes.description: Slow-braised beef shank — the bone marrow enriches the sauce as it cooks. A Chadian celebration dish.
instructions: Brown beef shanks in oil
Add onion, garlic, cook until soft
Add tomato paste, bay leaf, chili, Maggi
Add water to cover
Simmer 90 min until meat falls off bone
The marrow melts into the sauce
Serve over rice

recipes.name: Fried Sweet Potato Chips
recipes.description: Crispy, spicy sweet potato chips.
instructions: Slice sweet potatoes thin
Deep fry until crispy
Season with salt and chili

recipes.name: Beignets au Niébé
recipes.description: Cowpea fritters — airy inside, crispy outside, sold at markets across N'Djamena.
instructions: Blend soaked cowpeas with onion, pepper to thick paste
Whip paste until airy
Season with salt
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil
Fry until golden
Serve hot with pepper sauce

recipes.name: Brochettes de Mouton
recipes.description: Chad's night market staple — lamb skewers coated in yaji peanut spice and grilled over charcoal. N'Djamena's evening grilling scene, with smoke-filled streets and the sizzle of meat on charcoal, has become viral content for Sahel food tourism.
ingredients: Yaji spice: ground peanuts, cayenne, ginger, garlic powder, onion powder, salt
instructions: Cube lamb into bite-sized pieces
Make yaji spice mix: grind peanuts and mix with all spices
Coat lamb generously in yaji
Thread onto skewers
Grill over charcoal until charred edges but pink inside — 8 min
Serve with raw onion rings and lemon
These are the heartbeat of N'Djamena's night markets — charcoal grills line every street after sunset

recipes.name: Honey-Roasted Peanuts
recipes.description: Caramelized honey peanuts.
instructions: Toast peanuts in dry pan
Drizzle with honey, toss
Cook until caramelized
Sprinkle salt, cool

recipes.name: Bouillie Sucrée
recipes.description: Sweet millet porridge enriched with peanut butter and milk — served as dessert or a nourishing snack.
instructions: Mix millet flour with cold milk to avoid lumps
Heat, stirring constantly
Cook until thick and creamy
Sweeten with sugar
Swirl in peanut butter
Serve warm

recipes.name: Jus de Tamarin
recipes.description: Tangy tamarind juice.
instructions: Soak tamarind in water 30 min
Squeeze and strain
Sweeten, serve cold

recipes.name: Bili-Bili
recipes.description: Traditional millet beer.
instructions: Soak and sprout millet
Grind, cook into mash
Ferment 2-3 days
Strain and serve

recipes.name: Karkanji
recipes.description: Hibiscus drink with a strong ginger kick — Chad's version is more gingery than other West African bissap.
instructions: Boil hibiscus and ginger together 10 min
Strain, pressing out all flavor
Sweeten with sugar
Add mint leaves
Chill thoroughly

recipes.name: Pan Amasado
recipes.description: Traditional Chilean handmade bread rolls
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, water, salt, sugar, oil
Knead 10 minutes until smooth
Let rise 1 hour
Shape into rolls
Let proof 30 minutes
Brush with water
Sprinkle sesame seeds
Bake at 400°F for 30-35 minutes
Should be golden and crusty
recipes.fun_fact: Pan Amasado is sold fresh daily at Chilean bakeries and street corners

recipes.name: Pastel de Choclo
recipes.description: Chilean savory corn and meat pie
instructions: Brown meat with onion and garlic
Season with cumin
Layer meat in baking dish
Add sliced eggs and olives
Blend corn with milk and butter
Season corn mixture
Pour corn topping over meat
Bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes until golden
Corn top should be slightly dry
recipes.fun_fact: Pastel de Choclo is Chile's national dish and is served at celebrations

recipes.name: Cazuela
recipes.description: Chilean stew with beef, potatoes, and vegetables
instructions: Heat oil, brown beef
Sauté onions and garlic
Add potatoes, carrots, pepper
Add broth, bay leaf, cumin
Bring to boil
Reduce heat, simmer 35-40 minutes
Vegetables should be tender
Add pumpkin if desired
Simmer 10 more minutes
Season with salt and pepper
Serve in clay cazuela if available
recipes.fun_fact: Cazuela is an everyday Chilean dish served in homes and restaurants

recipes.name: Completo
recipes.description: Chilean loaded hot dog with toppings
instructions: Cook hot dog
Place in toasted bun
Add mayo
Top with sliced avocado
Add tomato slice
Add diced onion
Add sauerkraut
Serve immediately
recipes.fun_fact: Completo is Chile's popular street food and national fast food

recipes.name: Mote con Huesillo
recipes.description: Chilean summer drink with wheat and peach
instructions: Soak peaches in water 30 minutes
Bring water with peaches to boil
Add sugar and cinnamon
Simmer 20 minutes
Cool and strain
Keep some peach flesh in broth
Add mote to broth
Chill thoroughly
Serve in glass with spoon and straw
Drink broth and eat wheat/peach with spoon
recipes.fun_fact: Mote con Huesillo is Chile's iconic summer drink sold by street vendors

recipes.name: Murtado
recipes.description: Chilean drink made with myrtle berries
instructions: Crush myrtle berries
Steep in sparkling water
Let infuse 15 minutes
Strain
Add sugar to taste
Serve over ice
tips: Seasonal drink when myrtle is in season
recipes.fun_fact: Murtado is a traditional Chilean Mapuche drink

recipes.name: Chilean Wine
recipes.description: World-class Chilean wine
instructions: Pour into wine glass
Allow to breathe
Pair with Chilean food
Enjoy the rich flavors
tips: Chile is world's top wine producer
recipes.fun_fact: Chilean wines are world-renowned and considered among the best in the world

recipes.name: Jianbing
recipes.description: Beijing's most popular street breakfast — cooked on circular griddles by vendors on every corner. The crunch of the baocui inside the soft egg crêpe is essential.
ingredients: Batter: mung bean flour, wheat flour, water
instructions: Spread thin batter on hot round griddle
Crack egg on top, spread with a spatula
Sprinkle scallions and cilantro
Flip when set
Brush with sweet bean paste and chili sauce
Place crispy cracker on top
Fold into thirds
Serve immediately — the contrast of soft crêpe and shatteringly crispy cracker is the whole point

recipes.name: Congee
recipes.description: The universal Chinese comfort food — silky rice porridge simmered until the grains dissolve. Every region adds its own toppings.
ingredients: Toppings: preserved egg (pidan), pork floss, scallions, soy sauce, sesame oil, fried dough sticks (youtiao)
instructions: Rinse rice, add to pot with water
Bring to boil, reduce to low simmer
Cook 40-45 min, stirring occasionally — the rice grains break down into silky porridge
The consistency should be flowing, not thick
Ladle into bowls
Top with preserved egg, pork floss, scallions, a drizzle of soy and sesame oil
Serve with youtiao for dipping

recipes.name: Xiaolongbao
recipes.description: Shanghai's legendary soup dumplings — the liquid inside is solidified stock that melts during steaming. The eating technique is a rite of passage.
ingredients: Dough: 300g flour, hot water, pinch salt
Filling: 300g pork (minced), ginger, scallion, soy sauce, sesame oil, Shaoxing wine, white pepper, sugar
Aspic: rich pork or chicken stock chilled until set, then diced small
instructions: Make dough, rest 30 min
Mix filling with diced aspic — this melts into soup during steaming
Divide dough into small portions, roll very thin wrappers
Pleat 18+ folds around filling, pinch closed at top
Place on parchment in bamboo steamer
Steam 8-10 min
Serve with black vinegar and ginger
To eat: lift carefully by the top knot, place on spoon, bite a small hole, sip the soup, then eat

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.description: Named after a Qing dynasty official — the authentic Sichuan version uses dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorn for málà (numbing-spicy) heat, not sweet sauce.
ingredients: Marinade: soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, cornstarch
Sauce: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch, sesame oil
instructions: Marinate chicken 15 min
Mix sauce ingredients in a bowl
Heat wok until smoking, add oil
Fry dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant — do not burn
Add chicken, stir-fry until white
Add garlic, ginger, scallion whites
Pour in sauce, toss until glossy and thick
Add peanuts at the very end — they must stay crunchy
Garnish with scallion greens

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu
recipes.description: Born in a Chengdu restaurant in 1862 — the pockmarked grandmother's tofu. The numbing-spicy-savory combination defines Sichuan cuisine.
instructions: Gently blanch tofu cubes in salted water, drain
Stir-fry pork until crumbly and browned
Push to side, add doubanjiang, fry until oil turns red
Add fermented black beans, garlic, ginger
Add broth, soy sauce, wine
Gently slide in tofu cubes — do not stir roughly or they break
Simmer 5 min, add cornstarch slurry to thicken
Finish with generous ground Sichuan peppercorn and chili oil

recipes.name: Dim Sum: Har Gow & Siu
recipes.full_name: Dim Sum: Har Gow & Siu Mai
recipes.description: The two pillars of Cantonese dim sum — har gow's translucent shrimp dumplings and siu mai's open-topped pork cups. Yum cha (tea drinking) without them is unthinkable.
ingredients: Har gow: wheat starch, tapioca starch, hot water, shrimp, bamboo shoots, sesame oil, white pepper, salt
Siu mai: wonton wrappers, pork, shrimp, shiitake mushrooms, soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch
instructions: Har gow dough: mix wheat starch and tapioca starch with boiling water, knead smooth
Roll thin translucent wrappers
Fill with chopped shrimp and bamboo shoot mixture
Pleat wrapper around filling
Siu mai: mix pork, chopped shrimp, mushroom, season
Fill wonton wrappers, gather around filling leaving top open
Steam both in bamboo steamers 8-10 min
Har gow wrappers should be translucent, revealing the pink shrimp inside

recipes.name: Biang Biang Noodles
recipes.description: Xi'an's legendary belt-wide hand-pulled noodles — the slapping technique against the counter and the dramatic sizzle of hot oil over raw chili and garlic are two of the most viral sounds in food content. Named after the most complex Chinese character, which is itself onomatopoeia for the slapping sound.
ingredients: Dough: 500g high-gluten flour, 250ml water, 1 tsp salt, oil for resting
Chili oil topping: dried chili flakes, Sichuan peppercorn, garlic, sesame oil, neutral oil
instructions: Make dough: mix flour, salt, water. Knead 15 min until very smooth
Rest covered in oil for at least 1 hour (up to 4 hours)
Divide into portions, roll into logs
To pull: hold both ends of a log, slap the middle against the counter repeatedly, stretching
Pull and slap until the noodle is belt-wide — 3-4cm across and very long
Boil noodles 2-3 min (they're thick, so they stay chewy)
Blanch greens in the same water
Top noodles with soy sauce, vinegar, minced garlic, chili flakes
Heat oil until smoking, pour directly over the chili and garlic — the sizzle is the point
Toss and eat — the oil hitting the raw garlic and chili creates the flavor explosion

recipes.name: Peking Duck
recipes.description: Imperial Beijing's masterpiece — the duck is air-dried for a day, then roasted until the skin is paper-thin and crackling. The skin is served first, and eaten separately for a reason.
ingredients: Hoisin sauce or sweet bean sauce
instructions: Pour boiling water over duck to tighten skin, dry thoroughly
Rub cavity with five-spice and salt
Brush skin with maltose-water mixture
Hang in cool, airy place 12-24 hours until skin is dry as paper (use a fan)
Roast at 240°C for 45-60 min, rotating — skin should be lacquered and shatteringly crispy
Rest 10 min
Carve skin in thin slices (the skin is the star)
Place skin and meat on pancake, add scallion, cucumber, hoisin
Roll and eat

recipes.name: Hongshao Rou
recipes.full_name: Hongshao Rou (Red-Braised Pork Belly, 红烧肉)
recipes.description: Mao Zedong's favorite dish — Hunan-style red-braised pork belly. The combination of caramelized sugar, soy, and slow braising creates an impossibly rich, glossy sauce.
instructions: Blanch pork belly cubes, rinse
Caramelize rock sugar in dry wok until amber
Add pork, toss to coat in caramel
Add ginger, star anise, cinnamon, scallions
Add Shaoxing wine, light and dark soy sauce
Add water to just cover
Bring to boil, reduce to gentle simmer
Braise covered 60-75 min until meltingly tender
Uncover, raise heat to reduce sauce until glossy and thick — it should coat each piece

recipes.name: Sichuan Hot Pot
recipes.description: Chengdu's communal feast — a bubbling cauldron of chili oil, Sichuan peppercorn, and dozens of ingredients cooked tableside. The numbing heat builds over the meal.
ingredients: Broth base: beef tallow, 100g dried chilies, 50g Sichuan peppercorns, doubanjiang, garlic, ginger, star anise, cassia bark, fennel, cloves, white cardamom
Dipping ingredients: thinly sliced beef, lamb, tofu, mushrooms, leafy greens, glass noodles, lotus root, quail eggs
Dipping sauce: sesame oil, minced garlic, oyster sauce, cilantro
instructions: Melt beef tallow, fry dried chilies and peppercorns until fragrant
Add doubanjiang, fry until oil turns deep red
Add aromatics and spices
Add stock, bring to rolling boil
Transfer to tabletop burner
Each person cooks ingredients in the bubbling broth — thin meat takes 10 seconds, vegetables a bit longer
Dip into sesame oil-garlic sauce before eating
Keep adding ingredients and broth as you go

recipes.name: Scallion Pancakes
recipes.description: Shatteringly flaky layered pancakes with scallion — the coiling technique creates dozens of thin layers that separate into crispy sheets.
instructions: Mix flour with boiling water and cold water to form soft dough, rest 20 min
Roll flat, brush with sesame oil and salt
Scatter scallions generously
Roll into a log, coil into a spiral, flatten into disc
Fry in oil until golden and flaky on both sides
Cut into wedges

recipes.name: Baozi
recipes.description: Fluffy steamed buns stuffed with juicy pork and cabbage — breakfast, lunch, or snack, they're everywhere in China.
ingredients: Dough: 500g flour, 250ml warm water, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp oil
Filling: 400g ground pork, cabbage (chopped, salted, squeezed), ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper
instructions: Mix dough, knead until smooth, rise 1 hour
Mix filling ingredients
Divide dough into rounds, roll wrappers thick in center, thin at edges
Fill, pleat closed at top
Rise 15 min
Steam 12-15 min — the buns should be white and puffy
Do not open the steamer lid immediately — wait 2 min or they collapse

recipes.name: Jianbing
recipes.description: China's most famous breakfast street food — a savory crepe made on a giant round griddle in under 90 seconds. The egg-crack-and-spread, the cracker insertion, and the fold-and-cut are choreography. Jianbing-making videos are permanently viral — it's the world's most-watched street food being made.
ingredients: Batter: mung bean flour, wheat flour, water
instructions: Spread batter in thin circle on large round griddle
Crack egg directly onto crepe, spread with scraper
Sprinkle sesame seeds and green onion
Flip the crepe
Brush with hoisin and chili sauce
Place crispy cracker in center
Add pickled vegetables and cilantro
Fold the edges over into a rectangular packet
Cut in half and hand to customer
The entire process takes under 90 seconds — the speed is part of the show

recipes.name: Tangyuan
recipes.description: Sweet rice balls filled with molten black sesame — served during Lantern Festival and Winter Solstice. The round shape symbolizes family togetherness.
ingredients: Filling: black sesame paste, sugar, lard (or peanut butter)
Ginger syrup: ginger, water, rock sugar
instructions: Mix glutinous rice flour with water to smooth dough
Make filling: grind black sesame with sugar and lard into paste
Wrap small balls of filling inside rice dough balls
Make ginger syrup: simmer ginger with rock sugar
Boil tangyuan until they float, then 2 more min
Serve in warm ginger syrup

recipes.name: Egg Tarts
recipes.description: Cantonese-Portuguese egg tarts — silky custard in flaky pastry. A dim sum trolley staple and the pride of Macau.
ingredients: Pastry: 200g flour, 100g butter, 50g powdered sugar, 1 egg yolk, water
Custard: 3 eggs, 150ml milk, 100ml cream, 80g sugar, vanilla
instructions: Make pastry, chill, press into tart molds
Whisk custard ingredients, strain for smoothness
Fill tart shells three-quarters full
Bake at 210°C for 20-25 min until custard is just set with charred spots on top
Cool slightly — the custard jiggles when done right

recipes.name: Bubble Tea
recipes.description: Invented in Taiwan in the 1980s — now a global phenomenon. The chewy tapioca pearls (boba) at the bottom are the whole reason for the fat straw.
instructions: Cook tapioca pearls according to package — usually 20 min boiling, then soak in sugar syrup
Brew strong black tea, cool
Mix tea with milk and sugar syrup to taste
Add ice
Spoon tapioca pearls into glass
Pour tea over
Serve with wide straw

recipes.name: Chinese Tea
recipes.description: Not a recipe but a practice — gongfu tea ceremony is the Chinese art of tea. Short steeps from the same leaves, each cup slightly different. The vessel matters as much as the leaf.
ingredients: High-quality loose tea (oolong, pu-erh, or green)
instructions: Warm gaiwan and cups with hot water
Add tea leaves — fill gaiwan one-third full
First infusion: pour water over leaves, discard after 10 seconds (this washes and opens the leaves)
Second infusion: steep 20-30 seconds, pour into cups
Each subsequent steep adds 5-10 seconds
The same leaves yield 8-15 infusions, each with evolving flavor

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu
recipes.description: Sichuan classic - soft tofu in spicy sauce with ground pork. Name means pockmarked old woman who invented it
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
instructions: Cut tofu into cubes, set aside
Heat oil, add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute
Add pork, break up and cook until no pink
Stir in doubanjiang, cook 1 minute
Add soy sauce, sugar, white pepper, Sichuan peppercorns and broth
Bring to simmer, add tofu gently
Simmer 5 minutes
Add cornstarch slurry to thicken
Serve immediately with rice
tips: Handle tofu gently to avoid breaking. Sichuan peppercorns create numbing sensation
recipes.fun_fact: Mapo Tofu is Sichuan classic, name means pockmarked old woman who invented it. One of Eight Great Traditions of Chinese cuisine

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu
recipes.full_name: Mapo Tofu (Spicy Soft Tofu in Numbing Meat Sauce)
recipes.description: Soft tofu in numbing and spicy meat sauce - Sichuan dinner classic
ingredients: 400g silken or soft tofu, cut into cubes
1/2 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok or large skillet over medium-high heat
Add ground pork; stir-fry until no longer pink (3-4 minutes); remove
Add doubanjiang and chili oil; fry 1-2 minutes until fragrant and oil turns red
Add fermented black beans, garlic, ginger; stir-fry 1 minute
Return pork to wok
Add soy sauce, sugar, stock; bring to boil
Gently add tofu cubes; simmer 3-4 minutes
Add ground Sichuan peppercorns
Stir cornstarch mixture; pour into wok
Stir gently until sauce thickens (1-2 minutes)
Drizzle sesame oil; garnish with scallion
Serve immediately with white rice
tips: Numbing sensation from peppercorns is essential
recipes.fun_fact: Name possibly means 'pockmarked grandma'

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.full_name: Kung Pao Chicken (Spicy Stir-Fry with Peanuts)
recipes.description: Sichuan stir-fry with chicken, peanuts, and chilies - balanced heat
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, sesame oil in small bowl (sauce)
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok or large skillet over high heat
Add chicken cubes, stir-fry until cooked through (5-7 minutes), remove
Add chili oil to wok
Add dried chilies, cook 1 minute until fragrant
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook 30 seconds
Add onion and red pepper, stir-fry 2 minutes
Return chicken to wok
Pour sauce over chicken and vegetables
Add peanuts and ground Sichuan peppercorns
Stir cornstarch mixture into ingredients
Stir constantly until sauce thickens (1-2 minutes)
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with scallions
Serve immediately over steamed rice
tips: The Sichuan peppercorns create unique numbing sensation - essential for authentic flavor
recipes.fun_fact: Kung Pao Chicken was reportedly created for Ding Baozhen, a Chinese official in the Qing Dynasty
alternatives: Adjust heat with different chili amounts

recipes.name: Arepa de Huevo
recipes.description: A fried corn cake with a whole egg hidden inside — Cartagena's iconic street breakfast. The trick is frying twice to cook the egg without burning the arepa.
instructions: Mix cornmeal, water, salt to form dough
Shape into thick discs, fry until a crust forms
Remove from oil, carefully crack open a small hole in each
Crack a raw egg into the cavity
Seal the hole with a bit of dough
Return to oil, fry until egg is cooked through and arepa is golden
Drain and eat immediately

recipes.name: Changua
recipes.description: Bogotá's hangover cure — milk soup with poached eggs and stale bread. Simple, restorative, and beloved by bogotanos.
instructions: Heat milk and water together
Season with salt and scallion
When simmering, crack eggs directly into the liquid
Poach eggs gently 3-4 min
Add torn stale bread to soak
Garnish with cilantro
Serve in bowls with the poached eggs

recipes.name: Calentado
recipes.description: Yesterday's rice and beans refried with hogao sauce — Colombia's universal breakfast. Better the second time around.
instructions: Fry hogao: sauté diced onion and tomato with cumin until soft
Add leftover rice and beans, stir to combine and reheat
Fry eggs sunny-side up
Grill arepa and chorizo
Plate: rice-beans, egg on top, arepa and chorizo on the side

recipes.name: Changua
recipes.description: Bogotá's breakfast that divides the world — eggs poached in hot milk over stale bread. You either think it sounds bizarre or you become obsessed. Viral videos of Colombians making and defending changua have millions of views because the concept is so unfamiliar outside the Andes.
instructions: Heat milk and water together until simmering — do not boil hard
Add salt and green onion
Crack eggs directly into the simmering milk — poach them in the milk
The eggs should be just set — runny yolks are traditional
Tear stale bread into chunks and place in bowls
Ladle milky broth and poached eggs over bread
Garnish with cilantro
This is Bogotá's hangover cure and morning ritual — the bread soaks up the milky broth

recipes.name: Bandeja Paisa
recipes.description: Antioquia's famous platter — literally everything on one plate. A mountain of protein and carbs that defines paisa culture. Not a meal, a monument.
instructions: Cook beans with pork hock, cumin, salt until tender
Make hogao: sauté onion and tomato with cumin
Cook ground beef in hogao
Fry chicharrón until crackling and crispy
Fry ripe plantain slices until caramelized
Grill chorizo
Fry egg
Cook rice, warm arepa
Arrange everything on one massive plate — nothing touches if you do it right
Serve with avocado slices

recipes.name: Ajiaco Santafereño
recipes.description: Bogotá's signature soup — three types of potato, each playing a different role, flavored with the guascas herb found nowhere else. Rain-day food in a rain-day city.
ingredients: 3 types of potato: papa criolla (small yellow, dissolves), papa pastusa (floury), papa sabanera (waxy)
instructions: Boil chicken in salted water with corn, skim foam
After 20 min, add all three types of potato
The papa criolla will dissolve and thicken the soup naturally
Add guascas herb — this is what makes it ajiaco
Cook until chicken is tender, remove, shred, return
The soup should be thick from the dissolved potatoes
Serve in deep bowls with corn, topped with cream, capers, and avocado slices

recipes.name: Sancocho de Gallina
recipes.description: The Colombian grandmother's chicken soup — always made with a tough old hen for deeper flavor. Every region has its version; every version is Sunday lunch.
instructions: Simmer hen in large pot with garlic, scallion, cumin
Cook 45 min until hen is tender
Add corn, yuca, plantain, potato
Simmer 30 more min until everything is tender
Add chopped cilantro
Serve in big bowls with broth, meat, and vegetables
Eat alongside rice and avocado

recipes.name: Lechona Tolimense
recipes.description: A whole stuffed pig roasted for 10 hours — Tolima's festival dish. The crispy skin (cuerito) is fought over.
ingredients: Filling: dried yellow peas (cooked), rice, pork loin (cubed), onion, garlic, cumin, pepper, scallion
instructions: Clean whole pig, debone partially
Cook filling: mix peas, rice, seasoned pork loin
Stuff pig with filling
Sew closed
Roast in wood-fired oven 8-10 hours until skin is crackling and golden
Carve at the table
Serve with arepa — make sure every plate gets crispy skin, filling, and meat

recipes.name: Cazuela de Mariscos
recipes.description: Caribbean coast seafood stew in coconut milk — Cartagena at its most delicious. The Pacific coast version uses different fish but the same soul.
ingredients: Mixed seafood: shrimp, squid, fish, clams, crab
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, pepper with achiote and cumin
Add tomato, cook until broken down
Pour in coconut milk, bring to simmer
Add seafood: fish first, then squid, shrimp, clams last
Cook just until seafood is done — do not overcook
Finish with lime and cilantro
Serve with plantain chips

recipes.name: Lomo al Trapo
recipes.description: Beef tenderloin wrapped in cloth and salt, cooked directly in embers — a Colombian gaucho technique. Dramatic and perfectly cooked every time.
ingredients: Chimichurri: parsley, garlic, olive oil, vinegar
instructions: Dampen cloth, spread thick layer of coarse salt over it
Place beef tenderloin on salt
Cover completely with more salt — a thick crust
Wrap cloth tightly around salted beef, tie with string
Place directly in hot charcoal embers
Cook 25-30 min, turning once
The cloth chars, the salt forms a hard crust
Break crust open, slice — the meat inside is perfectly pink and seasoned only on the outside
Serve with chimichurri

recipes.name: Empanadas Colombianas
recipes.description: Crispy cornmeal empanadas — sold on every street corner in Colombia. The yellow comes from achiote. Always eaten with ají.
ingredients: Filling: potatoes (cubed small), shredded beef or pork, hogao, cumin
Ají sauce: cilantro, scallion, lime, chili, vinegar
instructions: Cook filling: mix seasoned meat with potatoes and hogao
Make dough with cornmeal, achiote water (for yellow color)
Form thin patties, fill with mixture
Fold into half-moon, seal edges firmly
Deep fry until golden and crispy
Serve with ají sauce

recipes.name: Buñuelos
recipes.description: Cheese-dough balls fried until puffy and golden — Christmas in Colombia isn't Christmas without buñuelos. The cheese makes them tangy inside.
instructions: Mix cheese, cornstarch, egg, sugar, baking powder into dough
Shape into ping-pong-sized balls
Deep fry, turning constantly, until golden all around — they puff up
Drain — they should be crispy outside and airy-cheesy inside

recipes.name: Tres Leches Cake
recipes.description: Sponge cake soaked in three milks — it should be saturated through and spoon-soft. Every bite is milk on milk on milk.
ingredients: Cake: 5 eggs, 1 cup sugar, 1 cup flour, vanilla
Soak: 1 can evaporated milk, 1 can condensed milk, 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until tripled in volume
Fold in flour gently — the air is everything
Bake at 175°C for 25-30 min
Cool completely
Mix three milks together, pour over cake slowly
Refrigerate overnight — the cake absorbs all the milk
Top with whipped cream and cinnamon dust

recipes.name: Obleas con Arequipe
recipes.description: Two paper-thin wafers sandwiching dulce de leche — sold at parks and plazas across Colombia. Simple and perfect.
instructions: Spread generous arequipe on one wafer
Add coconut, jam if desired
Press another wafer on top
Eat like a sandwich

recipes.name: Aguapanela con Limón
recipes.description: Dissolved raw cane sugar with lime — the most Colombian drink there is. Hot or cold, morning or night, it's everywhere.
instructions: Dissolve panela in hot water — it takes stirring
Add lime juice generously
Serve hot (for cold nights) or cold over ice (for hot days)
The hot version is Colombia's cold remedy; the cold version is Colombia's Gatorade

recipes.name: Lulada
recipes.description: Cali's signature drink — hand-crushed lulo fruit over ice. The tart, citrusy flavor can't be replicated with any other fruit.
instructions: Mash lulo fruit by hand — do not blend (texture matters)
Mix with water, sugar, lime juice
Serve over ice with fruit chunks still visible

recipes.name: Arepas
recipes.description: Colombian corn cakes served with fillings
instructions: Mix corn flour with water and salt
Let rest 5 minutes
Form into 4 cakes
Heat oil on griddle
Cook arepas 5-7 minutes per side until golden
Split and fill with cheese, ham, or other fillings
Serve hot
recipes.fun_fact: Arepas are Colombian staple and are eaten for any meal

recipes.name: Bandeja Paisa
recipes.description: Colombian hearty platter with rice, beans, meat
instructions: Prepare red beans with lard and cilantro
Cook rice
Fry ground beef with spices
Cook sausage and bacon
Fry pork
Fry plantain
Fry egg
Cook arepa
Arrange all components on large platter
Serve with avocado and tomato
recipes.fun_fact: Bandeja Paisa is Colombian national dish from Antioquia region

recipes.name: Ajiaco
recipes.description: Colombian creamy potato soup
instructions: Boil chicken in broth
Remove and shred chicken
Sauté onion and garlic
Add to broth
Add potatoes and plantains
Simmer 25 minutes
Add chicken and corn
Simmer 10 more minutes
Stir in cream
Serve with avocado, cilantro, lime wedges
recipes.fun_fact: Ajiaco is Colombian national soup

recipes.name: Empanada
recipes.description: Colombian fried pastry with filling
ingredients: Dough: 2 cups flour, 1 cup butter, 3/4 cup water
Filling: 1 lb ground meat, 1 onion, Spices, Corn, Raisins
instructions: Make dough, let rest
Brown meat with onion
Add spices, corn, raisins
Cool filling
Roll dough thin
Cut circles
Fill each
Fold and seal
Heat oil to 350°F
Deep fry until golden
Drain on paper towels
tips: Filling must be cool before sealing
recipes.fun_fact: Empanadas are Colombian street food

recipes.name: Flan
recipes.description: Colombian caramel custard
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F
Melt 1/2 cup sugar in saucepan
Pour caramel into flan dish
Blend eggs, condensed milk, evaporated milk, vanilla, salt
Pour into caramel-lined dish
Place in water bath
Bake 40-45 minutes
Center should be slightly jiggly
Cool and refrigerate
Invert onto plate
recipes.fun_fact: Flan is Colombian favorite dessert

recipes.name: Hot Chocolate Colombiano
recipes.description: Colombian thick hot chocolate
instructions: Heat milk with cinnamon
Add chopped chocolate
Whisk until completely melted
Add sugar
Pour into cups
Serve hot
Often with cheese or bread
recipes.fun_fact: Hot Chocolate Colombiano is traditional breakfast drink

recipes.name: Aguardiente
recipes.description: Colombian anise-flavored spirit
instructions: Serve at room temperature
Pour small shot
Sip or drink quickly
Often followed by beer
Traditional social drink
recipes.fun_fact: Aguardiente is Colombian national spirit

recipes.name: Mkatra Foutra
recipes.description: Dense coconut bread with sesame.
instructions: Mix dough with coconut milk, rise 1 hour
Shape into flat rounds
Top with sesame seeds
Bake at 200°C 25 min

recipes.name: Madaba
recipes.description: Spiced green banana in coconut milk.
instructions: Peel and slice green bananas
Sauté onion, garlic, spices
Add bananas and coconut milk
Simmer until bananas are tender

recipes.name: Malagasy-Style Rice Breakfast
recipes.description: Sweet rice porridge — reflecting the Malagasy influence on Comorian cuisine, eaten as a quick morning meal.
instructions: Cook rice in water and coconut milk until very soft
Sweeten with sugar and cinnamon
Serve warm as porridge

recipes.name: Pilaou
recipes.description: Comorian spiced meat rice.
instructions: Brown meat with onions and garlic
Add spices and tomato paste
Add rice and water
Cook until rice absorbs liquid
Serve topped with caramelized onions

recipes.name: Langouste Grillée
recipes.description: Grilled lobster with chili-garlic butter.
instructions: Split lobsters
Make garlic-chili butter
Grill lobsters, basting with butter
Squeeze lemon over
Serve with rice

recipes.name: Ntsolola
recipes.description: Green bananas in spiced coconut curry — Indian Ocean flavors meeting African cooking traditions.
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic in oil
Add turmeric and cardamom
Add tomato, cook until soft
Add green banana slices and coconut milk
Simmer until bananas are tender and sauce thickens
Season with salt

recipes.name: Mataba
recipes.description: Cassava leaves slow-cooked in coconut.
instructions: Pound cassava leaves
Boil with grated coconut 45 min
Add onion, garlic, tomato
Simmer until thick
Serve with rice

recipes.name: Grilled Fish with Pilipili Sauce
recipes.description: Grilled fish with fiery pilipili chili sauce.
ingredients: For pilipili: chili peppers, garlic, lemon juice, salt, oil
instructions: Blend chilies, garlic, lemon, oil into pilipili sauce
Season fish with salt
Grill until flaky
Serve with pilipili sauce and rice

recipes.name: Poulet au Coco
recipes.description: Chicken braised in coconut milk with Indian spices — the intersection of African, Arab, Indian, and French culinary traditions that defines Comorian food.
instructions: Brown chicken pieces
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger
Add turmeric, cardamom, tomato
Pour in coconut milk
Simmer 30 min until chicken is tender and sauce is rich
Finish with cilantro
Serve with white rice

recipes.name: Sambusa
recipes.description: Spiced meat samosas.
ingredients: Filling: ground beef, onion, cumin, chili
instructions: Make dough, rest
Cook spiced meat filling
Cut dough strips, fold triangles with filling
Deep fry until golden

recipes.name: Mkatra Siniya
recipes.description: Fermented rice cake baked until golden — fragrant with coconut and cardamom. Served at weddings and celebrations.
instructions: Mix rice flour, coconut milk, sugar, cardamom, yeast
Let ferment 1 hour until bubbly
Pour into greased pan
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 min until golden and set
Cut into squares

recipes.name: Samoussa aux Poissons
recipes.description: Comorian fish samosas — fresh tuna wrapped in crispy pastry, a fusion of Indian and African traditions on these volcanic islands. The Ramadan evening samoussa rush in Moroni, when every neighborhood has vendors frying hundreds at once, has become a viral scene of Indian Ocean food culture.
ingredients: Filling: 300g fresh tuna or bonito (flaked), onion, garlic, ginger, chili, cilantro, lemon juice
Wrappers: spring roll sheets or homemade dough (flour, water, oil)
instructions: Cook fish with onion, garlic, ginger until flaked and dry
Season with chili, cilantro, lemon juice — filling must be intense
Let filling cool completely
Cut wrappers into strips, fold into triangles, fill, seal with water paste
Deep fry at 170°C until golden and crispy — 3-4 min
Drain well
Serve hot with chili sauce
In Moroni, samoussa vendors line the streets at dusk during Ramadan — the fragrance is the advertisement

recipes.name: Halwa ya Comorien
recipes.description: Coconut semolina halwa.
instructions: Toast semolina in ghee
Add sugar and coconut milk
Stir until thick
Add cardamom and rose water
Press into mold, top with almonds

recipes.name: Ladoo
recipes.description: Indian-origin semolina sweets — a reflection of the Indian Ocean trade that shaped Comorian cuisine.
instructions: Toast semolina in ghee until golden and fragrant
Add sugar, cardamom, coconut, raisins
Cool slightly
Shape into balls while warm
Let firm up

recipes.name: Juice de Corossol
recipes.description: Creamy soursop juice.
instructions: Peel soursop, remove seeds
Blend flesh with water
Strain, add sugar and lime
Serve cold

recipes.name: Trembo
recipes.description: Fresh, sweet palm wine.
instructions: Tap coconut palm for sap
Collect in container
Serve fresh the same day

recipes.name: Chikwangue
recipes.description: Fermented cassava wrapped and boiled in banana leaves.
instructions: Wrap cassava paste in banana leaves
Boil 60 min until firm
Unwrap and slice
Serve with fish or stew

recipes.name: Beignets de Banane
recipes.description: Sweet banana fritters.
instructions: Mash bananas, mix with flour and sugar
Drop spoonfuls in hot oil
Fry until golden

recipes.name: Madesu
recipes.description: Creamy bean porridge — protein-rich breakfast across Brazzaville.
instructions: Cook beans until they start to break down
Mash slightly for creamy texture
Sauté onion in palm oil, add to beans
Season with salt
Serve with bread or chikwangue

recipes.name: Saka-Saka
recipes.description: The national dish — cassava leaves in palm oil with peanuts.
instructions: Boil pounded cassava leaves 45 min
Add palm oil, peanut butter
Add onion, garlic, fish
Simmer until thick

recipes.name: Poulet Moambé
recipes.description: Chicken braised in rich palm butter.
instructions: Brown chicken
Sauté onions, garlic, tomatoes
Add palm butter and water
Return chicken, simmer 30 min
Add okra, cook 10 min

recipes.name: Liboke
recipes.description: Fish steamed in banana leaves — the leaf imparts a subtle green flavor and keeps everything moist. A classic Congo River preparation.
instructions: Clean fish, season with lemon, salt, garlic, ginger
Layer banana leaves, place fish on top
Add sliced tomato, onion, pepper
Wrap tightly in banana leaves, tie with string
Grill or steam 25-30 min
Unwrap at the table
Serve with fufu or cassava

recipes.name: Poulet Moambé
recipes.full_name: Poulet Moambé (Chicken in Palm Butter Sauce)
recipes.description: The dish that both Congos claim as their own — chicken simmered in palm butter sauce until the rich, orange moambé coats everything. Considered one of Africa's greatest dishes, poulet moambé videos consistently go viral for the dramatic color and the communal fufu-dipping style of eating.
ingredients: 1 can palm butter (moambé sauce) or 300ml palm cream
instructions: Brown chicken pieces in palm oil
Sauté onion and garlic, add tomato paste
Add palm butter/moambé — this is the soul of the dish, a thick, orange, nutty sauce
Add water to thin slightly, add Maggi cube, chili
Simmer chicken in sauce 30-40 min until tender and sauce is thick and rich
Add okra or greens in last 10 min
The sauce should coat the back of a spoon — thick, orange-red, aromatic
Serve with fufu (cassava) or rice
This is Congo's number one dish — every family has their version

recipes.name: Makayabu
recipes.description: Salt cod stewed in tomato-palm oil sauce.
instructions: Soak fish overnight, drain, flake
Sauté onions, garlic, tomatoes in palm oil
Add fish, simmer 30 min
Season with chili

recipes.name: Mwambe
recipes.description: Chicken in smooth peanut sauce.
instructions: Brown chicken in palm oil
Blend tomatoes with peanut paste
Add sauce to chicken
Simmer 35 min
Serve with chikwangue or rice

recipes.name: Moyo
recipes.description: Spicy tomato-meat sauce — the everyday dinner across the Congo.
instructions: Brown meat in palm oil
Add onion and garlic, cook until soft
Add chopped tomatoes and chili
Add water, simmer 25 min until meat is tender and sauce is thick
Season with Maggi and salt
Serve over rice or with fufu

recipes.name: Mikate
recipes.description: Ring-shaped fried doughnuts.
instructions: Mix dough, rise 1 hour
Shape into rings
Deep fry until golden

recipes.name: Kwanga
recipes.description: Fermented cassava sticks wrapped in banana leaves — the slightly sour taste from fermentation is characteristic.
instructions: Ferment cassava in water 3-4 days
Pound into smooth paste
Shape into cylinder sticks
Wrap tightly in banana leaves
Steam 20 min until firm
Slice and serve with stews

recipes.name: Baked Plantain with Coconut
recipes.description: Baked plantains in coconut cream.
instructions: Split plantains, place in baking dish
Pour coconut cream over
Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon
Bake at 180°C 20 min

recipes.name: Beignets au Sucre
recipes.description: Sugar-coated fried dough — French beignet tradition embedded in Congolese daily life.
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, egg, warm milk into soft dough
Rise 1 hour
Shape into balls or rings
Deep fry until golden
Roll in sugar while warm

recipes.name: Ginger Beer
recipes.description: Spicy-sweet ginger beer.
instructions: Grate ginger, boil 10 min
Strain, add sugar and lemon
Chill, serve

recipes.name: Lotoko
recipes.description: Potent corn-based spirit.
instructions: Cook corn, mash
Ferment 5-7 days
Distill over fire

recipes.name: Gallo Pinto
recipes.description: Costa Rican rice and beans breakfast
instructions: Heat oil, sauté onion and garlic
Add bell pepper
Add cooked rice and beans
Add cumin
Stir frequently 10 minutes
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with cilantro
Serve with eggs if desired
recipes.fun_fact: Gallo Pinto is Costa Rican national breakfast

recipes.name: Casado
recipes.description: Costa Rican set meal with multiple components
instructions: Prepare rice
Prepare beans
Make mixed salad
Cook protein with spices
Fry plantain
Cook vegetables
Arrange all on plate
Serve with fresh tortillas
recipes.fun_fact: Casado is everyday Costa Rican lunch

recipes.name: Picadillo
recipes.description: Costa Rican ground beef hash
instructions: Brown beef in oil
Add onion and garlic
Add potatoes and carrot
Cook 15 minutes
Add cumin and broth
Simmer 10 minutes
Vegetables should be tender
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with cilantro
recipes.fun_fact: Picadillo is popular Costa Rican dinner

recipes.name: Costa Rican Empanada
recipes.description: Fried pastry with meat or cheese filling
instructions: Make dough with flour, water, salt, oil
Let rest 20 minutes
Brown filling ingredients
Roll dough thin
Cut into circles
Fill and fold
Deep fry at 350°F until golden
Drain on paper towels
recipes.fun_fact: Empanadas are popular Costa Rican street food

recipes.name: Costa Rican Flan
recipes.description: Caramel custard dessert
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F
Melt 1/2 cup sugar in saucepan
Pour into flan dish
Blend eggs, milks, vanilla, salt
Pour over caramel
Place in water bath
Bake 40-45 minutes
Center should jiggle slightly
Cool and refrigerate
recipes.fun_fact: Flan is popular Costa Rican dessert

recipes.name: Costa Rican Horchata
recipes.description: Sweet rice and cinnamon drink
instructions: Mix rice flour with small amount water
Make smooth paste
Add remaining water slowly
Add sugar, cinnamon, vanilla
Stir well
Chill thoroughly
Serve over ice
recipes.fun_fact: Horchata is traditional Costa Rican drink

recipes.name: Guaro
recipes.description: Costa Rican sugarcane spirit
instructions: Serve at room temperature
Can mix with fruit juice
Popular social drink
Strong spirit
recipes.fun_fact: Guaro is Costa Rican national spirit

recipes.name: Burek
recipes.description: Spiral phyllo pie with meat — eaten for breakfast at bakeries across Croatia. The burek is ordered by filling: meat (burek), cheese (sirnica), spinach (zeljanica).
ingredients: Filling: 500g ground beef and pork, 1 onion, salt, pepper
instructions: Sauté onion, add ground meat, cook until browned, season
Roll phyllo sheets thin, brush with oil
Place filling along the edge, roll into a log
Coil the log into a spiral in a round baking pan
Brush top with oil
Bake at 180°C for 35-40 min until golden and flaky
Serve with cold yogurt

recipes.name: Palačinke
recipes.description: Croatian crêpes — thinner and softer than American pancakes. The walnut-sugar filling is the traditional Dalmatian version.
ingredients: Nutella, jam, or walnuts with sugar for filling
instructions: Whisk eggs, flour, milk, salt into thin batter
Heat buttered pan, pour thin layer
Cook until bottom is golden, flip
Spread with Nutella, jam, or crushed walnuts mixed with sugar
Roll up
Dust with powdered sugar

recipes.name: Štrukli
recipes.description: Cottage cheese-filled rolled pastry — the pride of Zagreb's Zagorje region. Baked (zapečeni) is the classic way, boiled (kuhani) is the lighter version.
ingredients: Dough: 300g flour, 1 egg, 2 tbsp oil, warm water, salt
Filling: 500g fresh cottage cheese (svježi sir), 2 eggs, sour cream, salt
instructions: Make dough, rest 30 min
Stretch dough thin on floured cloth (like strudel)
Mix cottage cheese, eggs, sour cream, salt
Spread filling over stretched dough
Roll up using the cloth to help
Cut into portions
Place in buttered baking dish, top with sour cream
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 min until golden and bubbly

recipes.name: Peka
recipes.description: Meat and vegetables roasted under a cast-iron bell covered with embers — Dalmatia's most ancient and celebrated cooking method. You don't check it; you trust it.
instructions: Cut meat or octopus into pieces
Toss with vegetables, garlic, rosemary, oil, wine
Place in a round baking dish
Cover with peka bell (cast iron dome)
Pile hot coals on top and around the bell
Cook 90-120 min without opening
Everything steams and roasts simultaneously under the bell — the lid traps all the moisture

recipes.name: Pasticada
recipes.description: Dalmatia's wedding dish — beef larded with prosciutto, braised for hours in red wine with prunes. The sauce is blended smooth and poured over gnocchi. Reserved for the most important occasions.
instructions: Lard beef with strips of prosciutto using a larding needle
Marinate overnight in wine, vinegar, and aromatics
Brown beef on all sides in hot oil
Add chopped vegetables, cook until soft
Add marinade, tomato paste, prunes, cloves, bay leaf
Braise covered on low for 3 hours until fork-tender
Remove meat, blend sauce until smooth
Slice beef, serve with the rich dark sauce over gnocchi

recipes.name: Crni Rižot
recipes.description: Jet-black cuttlefish risotto — the ink turns everything midnight dark. A Dalmatian coast showstopper that stains your lips for hours.
ingredients: 500g cuttlefish or squid (cleaned, ink sacs reserved)
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil
Add sliced cuttlefish, cook until white
Add rice, toast 2 min
Add wine, stir until absorbed
Add fish stock one ladle at a time, stirring constantly
Halfway through, add reserved ink — the risotto turns jet black
Continue adding stock until rice is al dente and creamy
Finish with olive oil, parsley
Serve — the dramatic black color is the point

recipes.name: Ćevapi with Lepinja
recipes.description: Grilled meat fingers in flatbread — the Balkans' universal street food. Croatian ćevapi are smaller and the bread (lepinja) is round and pillowy.
instructions: Mix meat with grated onion, garlic, baking soda, salt, pepper
Refrigerate 2+ hours
Shape into small finger-sized links
Grill over charcoal, turning once
Serve in split lepinja bread with diced raw onion, ajvar, and kajmak

recipes.name: Brodetto
recipes.description: Adriatic fishermen's stew — each coastal town claims the original recipe. The rule: never stir, only shake the pot, so the fish stays whole.
ingredients: Mixed fish: scorpionfish, monkfish, mullet, shrimp
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic in olive oil
Add tomatoes, wine, vinegar, bay leaf
Simmer 10 min
Add firmest fish first, delicate fish and shrimp later
Cook gently 15-20 min — do not stir, only shake the pot
The fish should hold its shape in the rich tomato broth
Serve over polenta with parsley

recipes.name: Janjetina s Ražnja
recipes.description: Whole lamb on a spit — the centerpiece of every Dalmatian celebration. The slow rotation over coals takes patience, and the result is worth every hour.
instructions: Clean and prepare lamb
Rub with salt, garlic, rosemary, olive oil
Mount on spit over charcoal pit
Roast slowly, turning continuously, for 3+ hours
Baste with drippings — the skin should be crispy, the meat falling off the bone
Carve and serve with roasted potatoes and salad

recipes.name: Fritule
recipes.description: Tiny citrus-scented doughnut balls — the smell of Croatian Christmas. Sold by the dozen at every Advent market.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, eggs, milk, salt, citrus zest, rum
Fold in raisins
Let rise 1 hour
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil — they puff up
Fry until golden all around
Dust heavily with powdered sugar

recipes.name: Soparnik
recipes.description: Paper-thin double-crusted chard pie from Poljica — UNESCO intangible heritage. Traditionally baked on a stone under a peka bell.
ingredients: Dough: flour, water, olive oil, salt
Filling: Swiss chard (chopped), garlic, parsley, olive oil
instructions: Make thin dough, divide in two
Roll first half paper-thin
Spread with raw chopped chard, garlic, parsley
Cover with second paper-thin dough layer
Bake on hot stone or in very hot oven until crispy
Brush with olive oil
Cut into diamonds

recipes.name: Kremšnita
recipes.description: Samobor's famous custard slice — two layers of puff pastry sandwiching custard and whipped cream. Every cafe in the town of Samobor claims the best.
ingredients: Custard: 6 egg yolks, 150g sugar, 50g cornstarch, 750ml milk, vanilla
Whipped cream: 500ml heavy cream, 2 tbsp sugar
instructions: Bake puff pastry sheets at 200°C until golden and puffed
Make custard: whisk yolks, sugar, cornstarch, temper with hot milk, cook until thick
Cool custard completely
Whip cream to stiff peaks
Place one pastry sheet in pan
Spread custard layer, then whipped cream layer
Top with second pastry sheet
Dust with powdered sugar
Chill, cut into squares

recipes.name: Rožata
recipes.description: Dubrovnik's crème caramel — perfumed with rose liqueur. A Renaissance-era dessert from the Republic of Ragusa.
ingredients: Custard: 6 eggs, 150g sugar, 750ml milk, 1 tbsp rose liqueur (ružica), lemon zest, vanilla
instructions: Caramelize sugar in ramekins
Heat milk with lemon zest and vanilla
Whisk eggs with sugar
Temper with hot milk, add rose liqueur
Strain into caramelized ramekins
Bake in water bath at 160°C for 40-45 min
Chill overnight, unmold

recipes.name: Strukli
recipes.description: Zagreb's beloved baked cheese rolls — paper-thin stretched dough filled with fresh cheese and sour cream, baked until golden and bubbling. The dough-stretching technique (over a tablecloth, until you can read a newspaper through it) went viral as a showcase of Croatian grandmother cooking skills.
ingredients: Dough: 300g flour, 1 egg, 2 tbsp oil, warm water, salt
Filling: 500g fresh cow's cheese (quark/farmer's cheese), 200g sour cream, 2 eggs, salt
instructions: Make dough, knead until smooth, rest 30 min under warm bowl
Stretch dough on a floured tablecloth until paper-thin — you should see through it
Spread cheese filling over the entire surface
Roll up using the tablecloth to help — like a strudel
Cut into individual rolls about 8cm wide
Place rolls in buttered baking dish
Pour sour cream and melted butter over the top
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 min until golden and bubbling
The cheese should be creamy inside, the top golden and slightly crispy

recipes.name: Gemišt
recipes.description: Half wine, half sparkling water — Croatia's summer drink. The Graševina grape from Slavonia is the traditional choice.
instructions: Fill glass half with cold white wine
Top with cold sparkling water
Stir once
Drink in the sun

recipes.name: Rakija
recipes.description: Croatian fruit brandy — every family makes their own from whatever fruit grows in the garden. Offered to every guest as an act of hospitality; refusing is rude.
ingredients: Fruit: plums (šljivovica), grapes (lozovača), pears (kruškovac), or herbs (travarica)
instructions: Ferment fruit with sugar and water for weeks
Distill in copper still
Collect middle cut (the heart) — discard heads and tails
Age in glass or oak
Serve at room temperature in small glasses

recipes.name: Ajvar and Cheese Toast
recipes.description: Croatian breakfast toast
instructions: Toast bread
Spread ajvar
Add cheese
Drizzle olive oil
Serve warm
recipes.fun_fact: Toast is Croatian breakfast

recipes.name: Dalmatian Pasta Dish
recipes.description: Croatian pasta with seafood
instructions: Cook pasta
Sauté garlic
Add squid, cook 15 minutes
Add shrimp
Add white wine
Toss with pasta
Garnish with parsley
recipes.fun_fact: Dalmatian coast is famous

recipes.name: Pašticada
recipes.description: Croatian marinated beef stew
instructions: Marinate beef overnight
Brown in pot
Add vegetables
Add herbs and wine
Slow cook 2 hours
Add prunes
Serve with gnocchi
recipes.fun_fact: Pašticada is Croatian classic

recipes.name: Ćevapčići
recipes.description: Croatian grilled meat skewers
instructions: Mix meat with onion, spices
Form into long sausages
Grill over charcoal
Turn frequently
Serve with bread and ajvar
recipes.fun_fact: Ćevapčići are Balkan favorite

recipes.name: Krafne

Let rise
Divide and fill with jam
Let rise again
Deep fry until golden
Roll in powdered sugar

recipes.name: Croatian Coffee

Add finely ground coffee
Add sugar if desired
Heat until foaming
Pour into cup
Serve strong

recipes.name: Croatian Wine
recipes.description: Quality wine from Croatian regions
instructions: Serve at proper temperature
Red wines room temperature
White wines chilled
Enjoy with food

recipes.name: Tostada Cubana
recipes.description: Toasted buttered Cuban bread with coffee.

Spread with butter
Serve with café con leche

recipes.name: Tortilla Española
